detail.title: Machine-Learning Prediction of Cohesion and Internal Friction Angle for Rock Using Bayesian Methods and Meta-Heuristic Optimization
detail.abstract: Based on laboratory-measured physical and mechanical properties of rock materials, this study develops an integrated predictive and analytical framework for shear strength parameters by combining Bayesian methods, machine learning models, and meta-heuristic optimization, with the aim of improving prediction stability and reliability under small-sample conditions. Within a unified data construction and evaluation scheme, the performance characteristics of a Gaussian mixture model (GMM), bidirectional long short-term memory network (Bi-LSTM), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (Light-GBM), and random forest model (RF) are systematically compared for the prediction of cohesion and internal friction angle. By introducing Bayesian inference into different models, parameter uncertainty is explicitly characterized, thereby alleviating the instability of prediction results under small-sample and noisy data conditions. On this basis, multiple meta-heuristic algorithms are further employed to perform global optimization of key hyperparameters in representative models, enabling an investigation of how parameter configurations influence predictive behavior and error distribution characteristics. The results indicate that, under limited experimental data conditions, the Bayesian-based random forest model exhibits relatively superior performance in terms of prediction stability and consistency of error distributions, while meta-heuristic optimization can, to a certain extent, further improve model performance for the given dataset. Overall, the proposed modeling framework can serve as a complementary tool for the analysis and uncertainty assessment of rock shear strength parameters under data-limited conditions, and provides new insights into intelligent modeling strategies and stability evaluation of rock mechanical parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合贝叶斯方法、机器学习模型和元启发式优化的集成框架，用于在小样本条件下预测岩石抗剪强度参数（内聚力和内摩擦角）。研究表明，基于贝叶斯的随机森林模型在预测稳定性和误差分布一致性方面表现最佳，元启发式优化可进一步改善模型性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在小样本条件下提高岩石抗剪强度参数（内聚力和内摩擦角）预测的稳定性和可靠性？
AI.motivation: 实验室测量的岩石物理力学性质数据往往样本量有限，传统方法在小样本和噪声数据条件下预测稳定性不足，亟需一种集成预测与分析框架来改善预测的不确定性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯推断（量化参数不确定性）、机器学习模型（GMM、Bi-LSTM、Light-GBM、RF）、元启发式优化算法（全局超参数优化）
AI.method: 在统一数据构建与评估框架下，系统比较GMM、Bi-LSTM、Light-GBM和RF四种模型的性能；引入贝叶斯推断刻画参数不确定性；采用多种元启发式算法进行关键超参数全局优化。
AI.findings: （1）贝叶斯随机森林模型在预测稳定性和误差分布一致性方面表现最佳；（2）元启发式优化可在一定程度上进一步提升模型性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种融合贝叶斯方法、机器学习和元启发式优化的集成建模框架，为小样本条件下岩石力学参数的智能建模与稳定性评估提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可作为数据有限条件下岩石抗剪强度参数分析与不确定性评估的补充工具，对岩土工程设计和安全评估具有实际应用价值。

title: Comparison of Basel III-IV and SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7 in the Context of Banking Regulation and Financial Sovereignty

detail.title: Comparison of Basel III-IV and SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7 in the Context of Banking Regulation and Financial Sovereignty
detail.abstract: This article provides a direct comparison between the international banking regulation standards Basel III-IV and the author's standard SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7. For the sake of objectivity and precision, all conclusions are based on the official regulatory documents of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS). It is argued that the current standards are effective only within a fiat paradigm, treating empty debt obligations as if they were fully fledged assets. It is shown that Sections 18-20 and the mathematical core of SVWORLD 73.5 already implement all instruments for regulating capital, liquidity, and risk, but they are built on the assessment of real economic value rather than nominal value. The standard does not merely replicate Basel; it fully replaces it, being stricter, more transparent, and safer for national sovereignty. Special attention is given to the principle of subordinating traditional microeconomic indicators to a sovereign filter of real backing, as well as to the extension of automatic regulatory mechanisms across the entire financial system.

AI.tldr: 本文直接比较了巴塞尔III-IV国际银行监管标准与作者自创的SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7标准，认为现有标准仅在法定货币范式下有效，将空头债务义务视为完整资产，而SVWORLD标准基于真实经济价值评估，更严格、更透明、更有利于国家主权。
AI.research_question: 巴塞尔III-IV国际银行监管标准与SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7标准在资本、流动性和风险监管方面有何本质差异？
AI.motivation: 作者认为现行巴塞尔标准仅在法定货币范式下有效，将空头债务义务当作完整资产来对待，存在根本性缺陷，需要提出替代性的监管框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 真实经济价值评估理论、主权主权过滤器原则、法定货币范式批判、微观经济指标服从宏观主权约束的理论。
AI.method: 基于巴塞尔银行监管委员会官方监管文件的直接比较分析，对SVWORLD STANDARD 73.5 v1.7的数学核心与条款进行逻辑推演。
AI.findings: 巴塞尔标准仅适用于法定货币范式，将空头债务义务视为完整资产；SVWORLD标准第18-20节及数学核心已实现所有资本、流动性和风险监管工具，但基于真实经济价值而非名义价值评估；SVWORLD标准更严格、更透明、更安全；其将传统微观经济指标置于真实支撑的主权过滤器之下，并将自动监管机制扩展至整个金融体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以真实经济价值替代名义价值的监管评估范式，建立了微观指标服从主权过滤器的理论原则，拓展了自动监管机制覆盖全金融体系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际银行监管提供了一个替代性标准方案，强调国家主权安全和透明度，可被用于评估和改革现有巴塞尔框架。

title: Geopolitical Risk in the Euro Area: Measurement and Transmission
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank, Deutsche Bundesbank, Deutsche Bundesbank,  and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk in the Euro Area: Measurement and Transmission
detail.abstract: Geopolitical risk is a major concern for the euro area, yet widely used measures largely reflect a US perspective. We introduce a geopolitical risk indicator tailored to the euro area using local European news sources. Shocks to this index have significant recessionary and inflationary consequences in the euro area, effects that would be missed when relying on the corresponding US-based measure. We estimate that the Russo Ukrainian War imposed substantial output losses and inflationary pressures on the euro area in 2022. Combining structural scenario analysis with end-of-sample now casting, we show that euro area prospects are highly sensitive to future developments in geopolitical risk. We complement these analyses with two news-based measures of sanctions intensity and shortages for the euro area.

AI.tldr: 本文为欧元区构建了基于欧洲本地新闻来源的地缘政治风险指标，发现该指标冲击对欧元区具有显著的衰退和通胀效应，而基于美国的指标会遗漏这些影响。研究估计2022年俄乌战争给欧元区带来了巨大的产出损失和通胀压力，并表明欧元区前景对地缘政治风险未来发展高度敏感。文章还补充构建了制裁强度和短缺两个新闻指标。
AI.research_question: 欧元区特有的地缘政治风险如何影响其宏观经济，以及现有以美国为中心的指标是否低估了这种影响？
AI.motivation: 现有地缘政治风险指标主要反映美国视角，无法准确捕捉欧元区面临的地缘政治风险冲击，尤其是在俄乌战争等对欧洲影响重大的地缘事件中，需要构建欧元区专属指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险的经济影响理论；新闻文本分析与指标构建方法；结构情景分析与期末现时预测方法。
AI.method: 利用欧洲本地新闻来源，通过文本分析方法构建欧元区地缘政治风险指数；采用结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型进行冲击效应分析；结合结构情景分析与期末现时预测（nowcasting）评估经济前景敏感性；构建制裁强度和短缺两个辅助新闻指标。
AI.findings: （1）欧元区地缘政治风险冲击会导致显著的经济衰退和通货膨胀；（2）美国指标会遗漏这些影响，说明地缘政治风险具有区域性特征；（3）2022年俄乌战争对欧元区造成了巨大的产出损失和通胀压力；（4）欧元区经济前景对地缘政治风险未来发展高度敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建了专门针对欧元区的地缘政治风险指标，揭示了地缘政治风险的区域异质性，证明美国中心指标在分析欧洲经济时存在显著偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧元区政策制定者提供了更精准的地缘政治风险监测工具；为评估俄乌战争对欧元区经济影响提供了量化证据；为预测欧元区经济前景和制定应对政策提供了分析框架。

title: Environmental Fallout of the U.S.–China Tariff War Across Brazil’s Forest Frontiers
affiliations: Purdue University, University of São Paulo (USP), University of São Paulo (USP), Purdue University, Purdue University, Purdue University, Purdue University and Purdue University

detail.title: Environmental Fallout of the U.S.–China Tariff War Across Brazil’s Forest Frontiers
detail.abstract: The 2018 U.S.–China tariff war sharply restructured global soybean trade, redirecting demand to Brazil after a >70% decline in U.S. exports to China. Using 30-m land-cover data (2002–2024) and causal time-series models, we estimate that soybean expansion contributed to 4.5 million hectares of additional forest loss per year after 2018 across Brazil’s major producing regions. These findings demonstrate how trade-driven supply-chain shifts can undermine forest conservation and sustainability goals, highlighting the need to integrate environmental risk and shock-response mechanisms into global trade governance.

AI.tldr: 2018年美中贸易战导致美国对华大豆出口骤降超70%，需求转向巴西。研究利用2002-2024年30米土地覆盖数据与因果时间序列模型发现，2018年后巴西主要产区每年新增约450万公顷森林因大豆扩张而损失，揭示贸易驱动的供应链转移会破坏森林保护与可持续发展目标。
AI.research_question: 2018年美中关税战引发的全球大豆贸易重构，如何通过供应链转移效应驱动巴西大豆扩张并导致森林损失？
AI.motivation: 国际贸易政策（如关税战）可能通过重塑全球供应链，意外地将环境压力转移至其他国家和地区，从而抵消局部地区的环保成效。研究旨在量化这种“泄漏效应”的规模，为全球贸易治理中纳入环境风险评估提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易诱导的土地利用变化理论、供应链转移的环境泄漏效应、因果推断与时间序列分析。
AI.method: 采用30米分辨率土地覆盖数据（2002-2024年）和因果时间序列模型，对比美中贸易战前后巴西大豆产区的森林砍伐变化，估计贸易冲击对森林损失的因果效应。
AI.findings: 2018年后，巴西主要大豆产区每年因大豆扩张额外损失约450万公顷森林，证明了贸易政策冲击可通过供应链重组造成大规模跨境环境破坏。
AI.theory_contributions: 为贸易驱动的环境泄漏效应提供了量化证据，拓展了土地利用变化与全球贸易治理交叉领域的理论框架，揭示了贸易政策冲击如何非线性地传导至生态敏感区。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示国际贸易协定和政策制定者需将环境风险纳入贸易治理机制，设计供应链冲击响应方案，避免以邻为壑的环境成本转移，推动更可持续的全球农产品贸易体系。

title: From Classroom to Courtroom and Back: Exit, Voice, and the Struggle Over Public Education in America
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: From Classroom to Courtroom and Back: Exit, Voice, and the Struggle Over Public Education in America

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: In Mahmoud v. Taylor, the Supreme Court recognized for the first time a constitutional right for religious parents to exempt their children from public school instruction, affirming LGBTQ+ identities. This Article argues that Mahmoud inaugurates a troubling new form of “opt-out constitutionalism”: a judicial model that privileges religious exit over civic engagement, transforms exposure to difference into a constitutional injury, and threatens the very foundations of public education in a pluralist democracy. Although framed as a defense of religious freedom, the Court’s decision in Mahmoud ultimately distorts the proper application of strict scrutiny, strays from the core commitments of political liberalism, and undermines the traditional civic mission assigned to public education. By constitutionalizing subjective offense and collapsing the distinction between exposure and coercion, the Court invites an era of fragmented, ideologically siloed education. This Article situates the Court’s turn in Mahmoud within the broader landscape of deepening political polarization and growing civic retreat and turns to comparative constitutional frameworks to identify institutional models that balance religious accommodation with the imperative of democratic integration. Reconstructing the doctrinal landscape, this Article offers a normative and institutional framework for resisting constitutionalized exit and re-centering voice in public education. It argues that preserving the public school as a site of civic encounter, not ideological retreat, is essential to sustaining constitutional democracy in an age of division.

AI.tldr: 本文批判美国最高法院在Mahmoud v. Taylor案中确立的“退出式宪政”模式——即赋予宗教父母让孩子退出公立学校LGBTQ+相关教学的权利，认为这种将宗教退出置于公民参与之上的司法模式，会损害公共教育的公民使命，加剧意识形态分裂，并威胁多元民主的基础。
AI.research_question: Mahmoud案所确立的“宗教退出”权利如何影响公共教育的公民整合功能？在政治极化的背景下，如何在宗教包容与民主整合之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: Mahmoud案是最高法院首次承认宗教父母有权让孩子退出涉及LGBTQ+身份认同的公立学校教学，这一判决可能开创危险的先例，将主观冒犯宪法化，削弱公立学校作为多元民主公民教育场所的功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治自由主义（political liberalism）、严格审查标准（strict scrutiny）、比较宪政框架、公民教育理论中的“声音”与“退出”二分法。
AI.method: doctrinal analysis（教义分析）、comparative constitutional analysis（比较宪法分析）、normative institutional framework construction（规范性制度框架构建）。
AI.findings: 1. Mahmoud案扭曲了严格审查的适用；2. 偏离了政治自由主义的核心承诺；3. 将主观冒犯等同于宪法性伤害，混淆了“接触”与“强制”；4. 可能导致意识形态碎片化的教育时代；5. 加剧政治极化和公民退缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“退出式宪政”（opt-out constitutionalism）这一理论概念，揭示了宗教退出权如何被宪法化并威胁民主整合；将比较宪法框架引入美国教育宪政分析，提供了平衡宗教包容与民主整合的制度模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者、教育决策者和法院提供了抵制“宪法化退出”的规范性和制度性框架；主张重新将“声音”（voice）而非“退出”（exit）置于公共教育的中心；强调保护公立学校作为公民相遇的场所。

title: Copyright Litigation After Generative AI

detail.title: Copyright Litigation After Generative AI
detail.abstract:
Courts and regulators have increasingly found that AI-generated content is not copyrightable, but that works created with AI assistance may receive protection for the human author’s contribution to or arrangement of AI-generated elements. This Article identifies an unforeseen consequence of this framework: it transforms copyright infringement analysis from a content-based inquiry into a process-based one. Because AI-generated content is often indistinguishable from human-authored material on its face, courts cannot perform the “filtration” analyses that copyright litigation typically requires—separating protectable from unprotectable elements—without investigating the process by which a work was created. Unlike ideas, facts, or other public domain materials, which can be identified from a work’s content, the scope of copyright in an AI-assisted work can be identified only through examination of the prompts, outputs, iterations, and editing decisions that gave rise to the final work. This shift has profound consequences for copyright’s litigation system: early disposition will be all but impossible, discovery costs will balloon, and opportunities for strategic behavior will abound.

 

The Article identifies this problem at its inception and considers solutions that might head it off. Courts might be tempted to abandon rigorous comparison in favor of holistic analysis or an identicalness standard, but both of these approaches would undermine copyright’s policy agenda. Instead, the Article proposes a range of mechanisms that would allow courts to continue using filtration, but make it more administrable: a graduated evidence disclosure requirement in litigation, under which plaintiffs who fail to produce creation records would face a heightened similarity standard; an expanded evidentiary role for the Copyright Office as a repository for AI process documentation; and technological tools that can help verify and refine the evidentiary record. Together, these proposals aim to preserve the most analytically sound form of infringement analysis while adapting its evidentiary demands to the realities of a world of ubiquitous AI-assisted creation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了AI辅助创作作品在版权侵权分析中引发的根本性转变：法院无法再仅凭作品内容进行传统的"过滤"分析，而必须审查创作过程（提示词、输出、迭代、编辑决策等），这导致诉讼成本激增、早期处置几乎不可能、策略行为机会增多。文章提出了分级证据披露要求、版权局扩大证据角色、技术工具辅助验证等解决方案。
AI.research_question: AI辅助创作作品如何改变版权侵权分析的传统框架？法院应如何应对由此引发的诉讼程序挑战？
AI.motivation: 法院和监管机构日益认定纯AI生成内容不可版权化，但AI辅助创作中人类作者的贡献可受保护。这一框架导致侵权分析从基于内容的审查转向基于过程的审查，带来重大诉讼程序问题，亟需在问题初现时加以识别和解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版权法中的"过滤"分析理论（区分可保护与不可保护要素）；AI生成内容与人类创作内容的区分框架；版权诉讼程序中的证据规则与早期处置机制。
AI.method: 法律分析方法，通过识别AI辅助创作对现有版权侵权分析框架的冲击，逻辑推演其诉讼程序后果，并比较不同解决方案的优劣。
AI.findings: 1) AI辅助创作使侵权分析从基于内容的审查转变为基于过程的审查；2) 这一转变导致早期处置几乎不可能、发现成本暴涨、策略行为机会增多；3) 整体性分析或完全相同标准会损害版权政策目标；4) 分级证据披露要求、版权局扩大角色、技术工具辅助验证是更优方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别并阐述AI辅助创作对版权侵权诉讼程序的深层影响，特别是"过滤"分析方法面临的不可操作性挑战，为AI与版权法的交叉研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三项可操作的制度建议：分级证据披露要求（未提供创作记录的原告面临更高相似度标准）、扩大版权局作为AI过程文件存储库的证据作用、利用技术工具验证和完善证据记录，为法院和立法者提供了应对AI版权诉讼挑战的具体路径。

title: Assessing Synergies, Linkages and the Role of Hainan Special Economic Zone in Development of Natural Rubber Ecosystem
affiliations: Maalexi Inc.

detail.title: Assessing Synergies, Linkages and the Role of Hainan Special Economic Zone in Development of Natural Rubber Ecosystem
detail.abstract:
China has successfully created value and wealth, by integrating its industrial and technological development with Global Value Chains through deployment of economic zones. This paper looks at Hainan Special Economic Zone (‘HSEZ’), which was established as the largest special economic zone in China and has grown into second largest contributor of Natural Rubber (‘NR’) production in China. HSEZ has played a key role in design and development of socio-economic policies by acting as a ‘greenhouse’ to test these policies, and in process delivering extraordinary results. The application of triple helix structure to design policies, utilize institutions and implement initiatives by the HSEZ has allowed it to develop some key clusters within the zone where NR ecosystem is regarded as a great accomplishment. This paper identifies the output variables for socio-economic impact rendered by the HSEZ, and output variables of the local NR ecosystem. It then correlates and regresses them to gain insight on the synergies and linkages between the HSEZ’s vibrant environment and the local NR ecosystem. It also looks into new technologies and innovations that are being diffused from universities and research centers with the help of the private sector, under liberal but protective regulations instituted by the government agencies, and seamlessly flowing into the local NR ecosystem. These innovations are helping to address challenges and transforming this traditional but strategic agricultural industry in China, thereby opening venues for its growth and sustainability. This study builds up on primary data collected from visit to the province, discussions with stakeholders in Hainan and analysis of secondary data from various public sources. The results show that HSEZ, has successfully created a ‘collaborative and conducive environment’ that binds key ingredients of the natural rubber ecosystem together. On one hand, Natural Rubber based entrepreneurial ecosystem has formed significant linkages within the HSEZ thereby influencing its gross regional product, government revenue, employment, investments, trade and innovation. On the other hand, NR based entrepreneurial ecosystem retains its uniqueness, and strengthens its contribution to the global and regional trade supply chains.

Keywords: Trade & Environment, Government Policy, Agriculture, Technological Change

JEL: F18, L78, O13, O33

AI.tldr: 本文研究了海南经济特区（HSEZ）如何通过三螺旋结构整合产学研与政府力量，创造协同环境，推动天然橡胶（NR）这一传统农业产业的创新与可持续发展，并分析了NR生态系统与HSEZ整体社会经济影响之间的关联性。
AI.research_question: 海南经济特区（HSEZ）的协同环境如何影响当地天然橡胶（NR）生态系统，以及两者之间的社会经济变量存在怎样的关联与协同效应？
AI.motivation: 中国通过经济特区成功融入全球价值链并创造财富，但现有研究对特区内部特定传统农业产业（如天然橡胶）与特区整体环境之间的协同机制缺乏深入分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索特区政策如何促进传统农业转型升级。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三螺旋结构理论（Triple Helix Model），即政府、大学/研究机构与产业三方协同创新的理论框架。
AI.method: 实地调研与利益相关者访谈获取一手数据，结合多种公开来源的二手数据，进行相关性与回归分析，探究HSEZ社会经济产出变量与NR生态系统产出变量之间的协同关系。
AI.findings: 1. HSEZ成功创造了“协作与有利的环境”，将NR生态系统的关键要素紧密联结；2. NR创业生态系统与HSEZ在地区生产总值、政府收入、就业、投资、贸易和创新等方面形成了显著关联；3. NR生态系统在融入特区发展的同时，保持了其独特性并增强了对全球与区域贸易供应链的贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 将三螺旋结构理论应用于中国经济特区内的传统农业生态系统分析，拓展了该理论在特定产业（天然橡胶）情境下的适用性，揭示了政府、产学研协同如何推动传统战略农业的现代化转型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济特区管理者提供了政策设计参考，表明通过构建“协作与有利的环境”可有效促进传统农业与区域经济协同发展；同时为天然橡胶等战略产业的可持续发展提供了可复制的区域发展模式。

title: DSAttNet: Dual Attention-guided CNN with Dempster-Shafer Fusionfor Medical Image Classification
affiliations: Guangzhou University, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou University and Guangzhou University

detail.title: DSAttNet: Dual Attention-guided CNN with Dempster-Shafer Fusionfor Medical Image Classification
detail.abstract: Medical image diagnosis is critical for the early detection of diseases, yet traditional methods are limited by subjective clinical judgment and variability in expertise, often leading to misdiagnosis and inefficiencies. Recent advancements in deep learning have revolutionized medical image analysis, enabling automated and highly accurate diagnostic solutions. This paper proposes DSAttNet, a novel convolutional neural network (CNN) framework that integrates dual attention mechanisms and Dempster-Shafer (D-S) theory for robust medical image classification.DSAttNet combines two independently trained CNNs—ConvNeXt-Base and DenseNet-201,each equipped with dual weight attention modules based on multi-scale convolutions to effectively extract critical features from medical images. The predictions from these base learners are processed using D-S theory with evidence conflict detector and new categories, enhancing the model’s ability to handle uncertainty and improving classification reliability. To evaluate the effectiveness and generalizability of DSAttNet, we conducted experiments on four diverse datasets: Brain Tumor Classification, Skin Cancer Diagnosis (ISIC 2018), Gastrointestinal Disease Classification (Kvasir), and Glaucoma Detection (REFUGE). Experimental results demonstrate that DSAttNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, with accuracy and F1 scores of 82.73% and 77.86% on the Brain Tumor dataset, 84.21% and 73.17% on ISIC 2018, 87.75% and 87.65% on Kvasir, and 92.25% and 72.58% on REFUGE, surpassing many recent models in the literature. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LHY-GZHU/DSAttNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSAttNet，一种融合双重注意力机制和Dempster-Shafer理论的CNN框架，用于医学图像分类。该模型结合ConvNeXt-Base和DenseNet-201两个独立CNN，通过多尺度卷积的双重注意力模块提取关键特征，并利用D-S理论处理预测中的不确定性。在四个医学数据集上取得了优于现有模型的分类性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用双重注意力机制和Dempster-Shafer证据理论提升医学图像分类的准确性和鲁棒性？
AI.motivation: 传统医学图像诊断依赖主观临床判断和经验差异，容易导致误诊和低效。现有深度学习方法在处理不确定性和分类可靠性方面仍存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重注意力机制（基于多尺度卷积的注意力模块）、Dempster-Shafer证据理论（含证据冲突检测器和新类别处理）
AI.method: 提出DSAttNet框架，集成ConvNeXt-Base和DenseNet-201两个独立CNN，每个CNN配备双权重注意力模块；利用D-S理论融合两个基学习器的预测结果，包含证据冲突检测器和新类别处理机制。
AI.findings: 在脑肿瘤分类（准确率82.73%，F1 77.86%）、皮肤癌诊断（84.21%，73.17%）、胃肠疾病分类（87.75%，87.65%）和青光眼检测（92.25%，72.58%）四个数据集上均达到SOTA性能，超越多个现有模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双重注意力机制与Dempster-Shafer证据理论相结合，提出了一种能够处理预测不确定性并提升分类可靠性的新框架；引入证据冲突检测器和新类别处理机制，丰富了D-S理论在深度学习中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医学图像诊断提供了高精度、高鲁棒性的自动化分类方案；在四种不同疾病类型的医学数据集上验证了模型的有效性和泛化能力；开源代码便于临床应用和后续研究。

title: Stopping the VA's Electronic Bridge to Nowhere
affiliations: Stanford University and E-COLOGY CORPORATION

detail.title: Stopping the VA's Electronic Bridge to Nowhere

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors do not have any financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study. Dr Schulman served as a Without Compensation (WOC) physician at the Durham VAMC from 1999 to 2018. Joseph Dal Molin is an internationally recognized expert in digital health strategy and serves as Without Compensation chairman of the WorldVistA 501(c)(3) charitable non-profit. His contributions to this article are his alone as an expert in digital health strategy, and are not those of WorldVistA.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was not funded.

detail.abstract: In April 2026, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) resumed deployments of Oracle's Cerner Electronic Health Record (EHR) at Veterans Health Administration (VHA) facilities, continuing a program whose lifecycle cost has escalated from an original $10 billion contract to an estimated $37-$50 billion. This article disputes the three foundational assumptions behind the 2017 decision to replace the VA's VistA with Cerner Millennium via sole-source contract: that VistA relied on obsolete technology, that interoperability with the Military Health System required vendor consolidation, and that VistA modernization was prohibitively costly. Each assumption was flawed at inception and has grown less defensible since. VistA's underlying technology is not obsolete it also powers Epic, the market's dominant EHR; VA and the Department of Defense pioneered standards-based data exchange long before Oracle was contracted; and the cost estimates used to justify the Cerner deal were based on a misreading of the evidence. Critically, two developments have fundamentally changed the modernization calculus: VistA's 130 instances have migrated to a federally certified cloud infrastructure, establishing a modern foundation for enterprise-wide modernization; and the advent of AIassisted coding makes VistA's codebase far more tractable to extend, accelerating timelines and slashing costs-making a decade-long modernization investment of $1-2 billion realistic, against $23-36 billion in remaining Oracle deployment costs. Meanwhile, Oracle deployments have caused patient safety failures, dramatic declines in clinician satisfaction, and persistent disruptions, with 16 of 18 GAO recommendations still unimplemented. Oracle's own nextgeneration EHR signals Millennium's obsolescence, raising questions about long-term support and yet another costly migration. VA should cancel further Oracle rollouts and invest in VistA's proven, modernizable foundation-a fiscally responsible path that better serves veterans, clinicians, and taxpayers. In April 2026, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) deployed Oracle's Cerner electronic health record (EHR) at four medical centers in Michigan 1-the first wave of thirteen installations planned this year. 2 This is not a simple technical update; it represents a substantial workflow change and an open-ended financial commitment at a resource-constrained department.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑了美国退伍军人事务部（VA）以千亿美元级成本从VistA系统迁移至Oracle Cerner电子健康记录（EHR）系统的三大基础假设，指出这些假设从出发就有缺陷。文章论证，由于VistA已完成云基础设施迁移，且AI辅助编码使其代码库更易扩展，继续投资VistA现代化（需10-20亿美元）远比继续部署Oracle（需230-360亿美元）更合理、更安全、更具成本效益。
AI.research_question: VA用Oracle Cerner替换VistA EHR系统的决策假设是否成立？在当前技术条件下，继续部署Oracle还是回归VistA现代化是更优选择？
AI.motivation: Oracle Cerner系统的部署已导致患者安全事故、临床满意度下降、运营持续中断，且成本从最初的100亿美元飙升至370-500亿美元，而GAO的18项建议中有16项未落实。与此同时，VistA已完成云迁移且AI技术使其现代化成本大幅下降，有必要重新评估这一重大公共政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术决策评估框架：从技术过时性、互操作性、成本效益三个维度，对2017年决策的三大基础假设进行事实核查与重新审视。
AI.method: 政策分析/论证研究。通过对原始决策假设的逐一驳斥，结合最新技术发展（云迁移、AI辅助编码）和实证数据（成本估算、系统性能、患者安全记录），进行对比分析。
AI.findings: (1) VistA技术并不过时——其底层技术（MUMPS）也为Epic所用；(2) VA与DoD早在Oracle合同之前就开创了标准化数据交换；(3) 用于证明Cerner交易合理性的成本估算基于对证据的误读；(4) VistA的130个实例已完成联邦认证的云迁移；(5) AI辅助编码使VistA代码库更易扩展，将现代化投资降至10-20亿美元，而Oracle剩余部署成本高达230-360亿美元；(6) Oracle部署已造成严重问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个质疑大型IT系统"换代式"替换决策的批判性分析框架，揭示了技术"过时"论断可能成为掩盖更高成本、更差绩效选择的修辞工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 向VA政策制定者提出明确政策建议：取消Oracle进一步部署，转而投资VistA现代化，以更低成本（10-20亿 vs 230-360亿美元）、更高安全性、更好用户体验服务退伍军人、临床医生和纳税人。

title: Health in All Policies in Practice A Competency Framework for Practitioners

detail.title: Health in All Policies in Practice A Competency Framework for Practitioners

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationships to report.
declarations.funderStatement: No funder.

keywords: Health in All Policies; HiAP; competency framework; public health workforce; Health Impact Assessment; Cumulative Impact Assessment; environmental justice; community engagement; public health practice; professional certification

detail.abstract:
Health in All Policies has become the dominant North American frame for integrating health and equity into cross-sector decision-making, but its practitioner workforce has never been formally defined. The 2013 Rudolph, Caplan, Ben-Moshe, and Dillon guide established HiAP as a working approach for U.S. state and local government; subsequent research, most recently Suter's 2025 multi-case study, has documented substantial variation in how HiAP is implemented. Implementation has continued through cycles of expansion, defunding, and federal institutional shift. The workforce has sustained the work largely on its own — through professional societies, state and local practice, tribal governments, philanthropic initiatives that come and go, and practitioner networks that survive funding cycles. The competencies distinguishing capable HiAP practice from compliance practice have not been articulated at the level of detail other public-health practice fields take for granted.

This paper offers a practitioner competency framework for HiAP practice. It is organized around seven domains and seven roles, with named competencies at each intersection. The framework addresses the governance and institutionalization work that distinguishes mature HiAP practice from policy advocacy, the implementation maturity progression documented in the Suter 2025 research, and the equity and engagement disciplines anchoring the field's commitment to communities most affected by health inequities. It develops a Lived Experience and Prior Learning Assessment pathway as a route into HiAP practice for practitioners whose preparation comes from organizing, tribal governance, or community-based practice rather than degree programs. The framework is a practitioner reference, not a consensus document, offered to support workforce development across the conditions HiAP work currently faces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"健康融入所有政策"（HiAP）从业者能力框架，涵盖七个领域和七个角色，为这一从未被正式定义的从业者群体提供了能力标准，并包含生活经验与先前学习评估路径，以支持非传统背景从业者的职业发展。
AI.research_question: HiAP实践者应具备哪些核心能力？如何构建区分成熟HiAP实践与合规性实践的能力框架？
AI.motivation: HiAP已成为北美健康与公平整合的主流框架，但其从业者群体从未被正式定义；现有实践者在缺乏系统能力标准的情况下独自维持工作，亟需构建能力框架以支持 workforce 发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力本位教育理论；实践成熟度递进模型（基于Suter 2025研究）；治理与制度化理论；公平与社区参与理论。
AI.method: 基于已有文献（Rudolph等人2013年的指南、Suter 2025年的多案例研究）和实践经验，构建概念性能力框架，包含七个领域×七个角色的能力矩阵。
AI.findings: 提出了一个由七个领域（治理、制度化、公平、社区参与等）和七个角色组成的二维能力矩阵；区分了成熟HiAP实践与政策倡导的区别；设计了生活经验与先前学习评估（Lived Experience and Prior Learning Assessment）路径，为非学位背景从业者提供进入渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统定义了HiAP实践者能力框架；将治理与制度化工作纳入HiAP实践的核心能力维度；建立了实践成熟度与能力要求之间的理论关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HiAP从业者提供了明确的能力发展参考；支持政府、非营利组织和资助方进行人才招聘、培训设计和绩效评估；通过生活经验与先前学习评估路径拓宽了从业者来源渠道，增强了 workforce 的多样性与包容性。

title: Little Impact of ChatGPT Availability on High School Student Test Score Performance
affiliations: Seattle University - Economics & Finance

detail.title: Little Impact of ChatGPT Availability on High School Student Test Score Performance
detail.abstract: In educational settings, AI can be used as a learning aid, but can also be used to avoid schoolwork, thereby passing classes while learning little. Many existing studies on the impact of AI on education focus on AI use in controlled settings or with specialized tools. In this paper, the dropoff in ChatGPT activity during non-school summer months in 2023 and 2024 is used to identify areas with heavy educational AI use and thus estimate the educational impact of AI as it is actually used. I find no meaningful impact of AI usage on high school test score averages in either direction. These results imply that, to the extent that high school students use AI to avoid learning, it either does not matter much for their test performance or is cancelled out by positive uses of AI in the aggregate.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ChatGPT在非暑假月份的活跃度下降现象，识别教育领域AI使用情况，发现AI使用对高中考试成绩无显著影响，暗示AI逃避学习与辅助学习的效果在总体上相互抵消。
AI.research_question: AI在真实教育场景中的使用对高中学生考试成绩有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI在受控环境或特定工具下的教育影响，但缺乏对AI在实际使用环境下教育效果的大规模实证估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI的双重角色理论：AI既可作为学习辅助工具提升学习效率，也可被用于逃避学习任务；效应抵消假说。
AI.method: 利用2023-2024年暑假期间ChatGPT活动量下降的自然实验，识别教育场景中的AI密集使用，分析其对高中考试成绩平均值的影响。
AI.findings: AI使用对高中考试成绩平均水平无显著正面或负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI在真实教育环境中总体效应为零的实证证据，支持了AI正面与负面作用在总体上相互抵消的假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 对教育政策制定者而言，AI对标准化考试成绩的直接影响有限，但需关注AI对学习过程和深层能力的潜在影响。

title: Health Impact Assessment in Practice: A Competency Framework for Practitioners

detail.title: Health Impact Assessment in Practice: A Competency Framework for Practitioners

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
Health Impact Assessment practice in North America rests on a workforce whose competencies have not been formally defined. Wales is the global reference for HIA workforce development; with the Health Impact Assessment (Wales) Regulations 2025, it becomes the first jurisdiction to require HIA by statute on a meaningful scale. North America operates differently: voluntary practice is the default, the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation–funded Health Impact Project closed in 2018, federal application of Cumulative Impact Assessment is currently paused, and neither statutory infrastructure nor sustained philanthropic foundation underwrites the field. The work has been kept alive by practitioner commitment, by the Society of Practitioners of Health Impact Assessment, by tribal HIA programs, by state environmental justice programs, and by academic training centers. Workforce expectations have not kept pace with actual practice.

This paper offers a practitioner competency framework for HIA in North America. It is organized around seven domains — foundations of HIA and CIA practice, screening and scoping, data and methods, community engagement and power, reporting and recommendations, monitoring and follow-through, and project management and stewardship — and seven roles, including a formal Community Partner / Co-Lead role with named competencies. It treats HIA and Cumulative Impact Assessment as parallel methodologies, addresses industry-commissioned HIA ethics directly, and crosswalks formally to the Wales HIA Support Unit framework. The framework is a practitioner reference, not a consensus document, offered as a contribution to the field's continued development under voluntary practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向北美健康影响评估（HIA）从业者的能力框架，涵盖七个领域和七个角色，旨在应对北美HIA领域缺乏法定基础设施和正式能力定义的现状。
AI.research_question: 北美健康影响评估（HIA）从业者应具备哪些核心能力？如何构建一个适应北美自愿实践环境的能力框架？
AI.motivation: 北美HIA实践依赖于一批能力尚未正式定义的从业者队伍。与威尔士不同，北美缺乏法定基础设施和持续的慈善资金支持，从业者靠个人承诺维持工作，而实践期望已落后于实际发展，亟需一个能力框架来指导职业发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力本位教育理论；实践共同体理论；HIA与累积影响评估（CIA）作为平行方法论；交叉参照威尔士HIA支持单元框架。
AI.method: 本文基于实践反思和从业者经验，提出了一个包含七个领域和七个角色的能力框架，作为实践者参考文件而非共识性文件。
AI.findings: 提出了七大能力领域：HIA/CIA实践基础、筛查与范围界定、数据与方法、社区参与与权力、报告与建议、监测与跟进、项目管理与管理。提出了七个角色，包括正式的社区合作伙伴/共同领导角色。框架直接处理了行业委托HIA的伦理问题，并与威尔士框架进行了正式对照。
AI.theory_contributions: 为北美HIA自愿实践环境提供了首个系统化的从业者能力框架；将HIA与累积影响评估作为平行方法论整合；提出了社区合作伙伴/共同领导的正式角色和能力要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为北美HIA从业者提供了能力发展的参考标准；帮助培训项目和从业者明确能力缺口；为行业委托HIA提供了伦理指南；促进了北美与威尔士HIA框架的对话与对照。

title: Nonlinear Tax Credits and Employment Responses to Wage Shocks: Evidence from the EITC
affiliations: Purdue University

detail.title: Nonlinear Tax Credits and Employment Responses to Wage Shocks: Evidence from the EITC
detail.abstract: The Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) is widely understood to raise average employment among low-income workers, but less is known about whether its nonlinear schedule changes how employment responds to economic shocks. This paper shows that the answer turns on the earnings-distribution incidence of the shock: the same EITC expansion stabilizes employment responses when eligible workers concentrate in the phase-out region, but destabilizes them when shocks compress wages at the bottom of the distribution and activate phase-in incentives. We introduce a commuting-zone average treatment effect (CZATE) that captures equilibrium labor market responses and exploit three quasi-experimental wage shocks---local economic booms, China import competition, and minimum-wage hikes---that differ in direction and where they strike the earnings distribution. A $100 increase in EITC generosity rotates the wage--employment slope by 0.05--0.20 percentage points per 1% wage change. Stabilization dominates in boom environments where eligible mass concentrates in the phase-out region; destabilization is concentrated among single, low-education women under adverse trade shocks, precisely the group with the densest phase-in exposure. Results are robust to contemporaneous welfare reform and multiple identification checks. The cyclical consequences of EITC expansions depend critically on the schedule position of marginal beneficiaries at the time of the shock.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的非线性结构如何调节就业对经济冲击的反应。研究发现，EITC是稳定还是放大就业波动，取决于冲击对收入分布的哪一部分产生影响：当冲击发生在EITC递减阶段时，EITC具有稳定作用；当冲击压缩低收入群体工资并激活递增阶段激励时，EITC反而会放大就业波动。
AI.research_question: 劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的非线性结构如何影响就业对经济冲击的响应？即EITC是稳定还是放大劳动力市场对经济冲击的就业反应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究广泛证实EITC能提高低收入群体的平均就业率，但对其非线性结构如何调节就业对经济冲击的周期性反应知之甚少。理解这一问题对于评估EITC在经济衰退期的自动稳定器功能至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: EITC的非线性结构理论：EITC包含递增阶段（phase-in）、平稳阶段（plateau）和递减阶段（phase-out），不同收入区间的工人面临不同的边际激励。当冲击发生在不同区间时，EITC的就业调节效应方向相反。
AI.method: 引入通勤区平均处理效应（CZATE）来捕捉均衡劳动力市场反应。利用三种准实验性工资冲击：地方经济繁荣、中国进口竞争和最低工资上涨，这些冲击在方向和影响收入分布的区间上各不相同。
AI.findings: EITC每增加100美元，会使工资-就业斜率旋转0.05-0.20个百分点每1%工资变化。在经济繁荣（冲击集中在递减阶段）时，EITC发挥稳定作用；在贸易冲击（压缩低收入工资，激活递增阶段激励）时，EITC放大就业波动，尤其是对单身、低教育女性群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了EITC非线性结构对就业周期性的异质性调节机制，表明EITC的自动稳定器效应取决于边际受益者在冲击发生时处于非线性工资补贴计划的哪个区间。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了EITC设计的精细指导：EITC的周期性效应取决于冲击类型和受影响群体的收入分布位置，在调整EITC参数时需要考虑不同经济环境下的稳定/放大效应。

title: DDUST-Net: Dual deep unfolding sparse transform network for hyperspectral image reconstruction
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University and Zhejiang University

detail.title: DDUST-Net: Dual deep unfolding sparse transform network for hyperspectral image reconstruction
detail.abstract: Compressive spectral imaging enables snapshot acquisition of 3D spectral data cube through coded modulation, but reconstruction from highly compressed 2D measurements remains a severely ill-posed inverse problem. Recently, deep unfolding networks have attracted considerable attention for their interpretability and reconstruction performance. However, most existing methods rely on implicit regularization and cannot explicitly model the structural properties of hyperspectral images. This limits their ability to exploit sparse information in highly aliased measurements and restrains further improvement in reconstruction accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a dual deep unfolding sparse transform network. A sparse transform module and a spectral-wise multi-head self-attention module are integrated into the denoising prior network. In particular, the sparse transform module is unfolded based on learned iterative shrinkage-thresholding algorithm to impose explicit transform-domain sparse constraints, improving local feature extraction. Meanwhile, the self-attention module captures global spectral correlations, enabling effective joint local and nonlocal optimization. Experiments on synthetic datasets show that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms in reconstruction accuracy and noise robustness. Results on real data further demonstrate its potential for practical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双重深度展开稀疏变换网络（Dual Deep Unfolding Sparse Transform Network），用于压缩光谱成像重建，通过显式稀疏约束和全局谱相关性建模提升重建精度和噪声鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用显式稀疏先验和全局谱相关性来提升压缩光谱成像的重建精度？
AI.motivation: 现有深度展开网络依赖隐式正则化，无法显式建模高光谱图像的结构属性，限制了高度混叠测量中稀疏信息的利用和重建精度的进一步提升。
AI.theoretical_framework: ISTA学习展开（Learned Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm）、稀疏变换（Sparse Transform）、谱多头自注意力（Spectral-wise Multi-head Self-attention）
AI.method: 提出双重深度展开稀疏变换网络，包含稀疏变换模块（基于L-ISTA展开，施加显式变换域稀疏约束）和谱多头自注意力模块（捕获全局谱相关性），实现局部与非局部联合优化。
AI.findings: 在合成数据集上，该方法在重建精度和噪声鲁棒性方面优于现有最先进算法；在真实数据上的实验结果进一步验证了其实用潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将显式稀疏变换约束以可展开方式集成到深度网络框架中，为压缩光谱成像的逆问题求解提供了新的结构化正则化范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高了压缩光谱成像的重建质量和抗噪能力，为快照式压缩光谱成像系统的实际应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Ethnic Discrimination in the Norwegian Rental Housing Market: Evidence from a Field Experiment
affiliations: Bank of Italy - Research Department, Oslo Metropolitan University, University of Oslo - Ragnar Frisch Centre for Economic Research, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Oslo Metropolitan University

detail.title: Ethnic Discrimination in the Norwegian Rental Housing Market: Evidence from a Field Experiment
detail.abstract: We study ethnic discrimination in the Norwegian rental housing market using a preregistered correspondence experiment with three fictitious male applicants. Two profiles - one with a Norwegian-sounding name and one with an Arabic-sounding name - are both presented as steadily employed warehouse workers, while a third profile with the same Norwegian-sounding name is described as unemployed. Using 2,853 applications submitted on Norway’s main rental platform, we find that the Arabic-named applicant receives substantially fewer positive responses than the otherwise identical Norwegiannamed applicant, with a callback rate close to that of the unemployed Norwegian applicant. Relative to an earlier Norwegian field experiment, the estimated gap does not indicate that discrimination has declined over time. We further show that differential treatment is stronger in tighter and more central rental markets, while it is not systematically related to local anti-immigration voting patterns. These findings suggest that unequal access to rental housing is shaped both by ethnicity and by market conditions that give landlords greater scope to screen applicants.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过挪威租赁住房市场的实地实验发现，阿拉伯语名字的求职者获得的积极回应显著少于挪威语名字的求职者，其回电率甚至与失业的挪威申请人相当。歧视在更紧张和更中心化的市场中更为严重，但与当地反移民投票模式无关。
AI.research_question: 挪威租赁住房市场中是否存在基于种族的歧视？这种歧视的程度如何？是否随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 先前研究已表明住房市场存在种族歧视，但较少关注歧视随时间的变化趋势以及市场条件如何调节歧视程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场歧视理论扩展至住房市场；市场条件（市场紧张度、地理位置）对歧视行为的调节作用。
AI.method: 预注册的通信实验（correspondence experiment），向挪威主要租赁平台提交2,853份申请，比较三名虚构男性申请人的回应率。
AI.findings: 阿拉伯名字申请人获得积极回应的概率显著低于挪威名字申请人，其回电率与失业的挪威申请人接近；歧视程度与早期实验相比未随时间下降；歧视在更紧张、更中心化的市场中更强；歧视与当地反移民投票模式无系统关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场条件（市场紧张度、地理位置）作为调节变量影响歧视程度，为歧视的理论机制提供了新的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证证据，表明住房市场歧视持续存在且与市场条件相关，提示应关注市场紧张地区的歧视问题，并采取针对性干预措施。

title: Leak-consistent Linear Cross-Attention for Audio-Visual SpikingNeural Networks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Changchun University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Leak-consistent Linear Cross-Attention for Audio-Visual SpikingNeural Networks
detail.abstract: Audio-Visual spiking neural networks (AV-SNNs)provide a promising paradigm for energyefficient multimodal perception on resource-constrained edge devices. However, existing AV-SNN fusion methods usually decouple LIF/PLIF-based token generation from subsequent attention feature mapping. As a result,static positive-valued mappings used in kernelized linear attention, such as ReLU or Softplus, cannot explicitly account for the amplitude variations induced by neuronal leakage dynamics, which can lead to scale inconsistency and unstable cross-modal interactions under different temporal configurations. To address this problem, we propose Leak-Consistent Linear Cross-Attention (LC-Linear), a linearcomplexity fusion framework that aligns attention feature mapping with PLIF tokenization dynamics. LC-Linear shares the learnable membrane time constant and the corresponding effective leakage factor from the PLIF tokenization stage, and constructs leakage-aware accumulation proxies for Query and Key features before kernelized attention computation. In addition,a dynamic normalization factor derived from the upper bound of geometric leakage accumulation is introduced to reduce feature scale drift and improve the numerical stability of the linear attention denominator,without adding independent learnable leakage parameters. Experiments on CREMA-D,UrbanSound8K-AV,and MNIST-DVS-NTIDIGITS show that LC-Linear achieves competitive classification performance and improved temporal robustness. On CREMA-D,it obtains 80.04%accuracy,76.4%robust accuracy under controlled temporal perturbations,and a temporal prediction instability of 0.118,demonstrating its effectiveness for stable and efficient audio-visual spiking fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Leak-Consistent Linear Cross-Attention (LC-Linear)，一种用于音频-视觉脉冲神经网络的高效融合框架，通过将注意力特征映射与PLIF令牌化动力学对齐，解决现有方法中因神经元泄漏动力学导致的尺度不一致和跨模态交互不稳定问题，在多个数据集上实现了竞争性分类性能和更好的时间鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决音频-视觉脉冲神经网络融合中，静态正映射（如ReLU/Softplus）无法捕捉神经元泄漏动力学引起的幅度变化，从而导致尺度不一致和跨模态交互不稳定的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有AV-SNN融合方法将基于LIF/PLIF的令牌生成与后续注意力特征映射解耦，导致静态映射无法解释神经元泄漏动力学带来的幅度变化，在不同时间配置下造成尺度不一致和不稳定的跨模态交互，影响融合性能和时间鲁棒性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）、PLIF神经元模型、线性注意力机制、泄漏感知累积代理、几何泄漏累积上界动态归一化
AI.method: 提出LC-Linear融合框架：1) 共享PLIF令牌化阶段的可学习膜时间常数和有效泄漏因子；2) 在核化线性注意力计算前构建泄漏感知的Query和Key累积代理；3) 引入基于几何泄漏累积上界的动态归一化因子，减少特征尺度漂移并提升线性注意力分母的数值稳定性。
AI.findings: 在CREMA-D、UrbanSound8K-AV和MNIST-DVS-NTIDIGITS数据集上，LC-Linear取得了竞争性分类性能；在CREMA-D上达到80.04%准确率，时间扰动下鲁棒准确率76.4%，时间预测不稳定性0.118，展示了在稳定高效音视频脉冲融合上的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了现有AV-SNN融合中静态映射与神经元泄漏动力学之间的尺度不一致问题；2) 提出将注意力特征映射与PLIF令牌化动力学对齐的理论框架；3) 引入基于几何泄漏累积上界的动态归一化方法，无需额外可学习参数。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为资源受限边缘设备上的高效多模态感知提供了更稳定的融合方案；2) 提升了模型在时间扰动下的鲁棒性和预测稳定性；3) 保持线性复杂度，适合实际部署。

title: ConfSurf: Confidence-Aware Neural Implicit Surface Reconstruction with a Unified Geometric Foundation Model
affiliations: Northeastern University, Northeastern University and Shenyang Aerospace University

detail.title: ConfSurf: Confidence-Aware Neural Implicit Surface Reconstruction with a Unified Geometric Foundation Model
detail.abstract: Neural implicit surface reconstruction increasingly relies on monocular priors to resolve geometric ambiguities. Existing methods suffer from two underexplored limitations. They depend on task-specific estimators with inconsistent outputs, and they apply spatially uniform trust that ignores heterogeneous prior errors. We propose ConfSurf to address both issues. At the prior extraction level, a unified geometric foundation model jointly produces metric depth, camera parameters, and per-pixel confidence in a single forward pass, from which surface normals are further derived. This ensures cross-modal consistency. At the prior fusion level, a single calibrated reliability signal drives adaptive ray selection, reliability-controlled along-ray sampling, and confidence-aware prior supervision. Our framework is agnostic to the foundation model and is instantiated with Depth Anything V3. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet show that ConfSurf reaches F-score@5cm of 93.73\% and 78.25\%, surpassing the strongest prior-guided baseline by 5.68 and 6.45 points. Training takes only 5.2 hours on a single RTX 3090.

AI.tldr: ConfSurf提出了一种基于统一几何基础模型的神经隐式表面重建方法，通过联合生成度量深度、相机参数和逐像素置信度，并利用校准后的可靠性信号实现自适应光线选择和置信度感知的监督，显著提升了重建精度和训练效率。
AI.research_question: 如何解决神经隐式表面重建中依赖任务特定估计器导致的输出不一致问题，以及空间均匀信任无法处理异构先验误差的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有神经隐式表面重建方法依赖单目先验解决几何歧义，但存在两个未充分探索的局限：一是依赖输出不一致的任务特定估计器，二是应用空间均匀信任而忽略了先验误差的异构性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一几何基础模型（Depth Anything V3）、跨模态一致性、校准可靠性信号、自适应光线选择、可靠性控制沿射线采样、置信度感知先验监督
AI.method: 在先验提取层面，使用统一的几何基础模型在单次前向传播中联合生成度量深度、相机参数和逐像素置信度，并进一步推导表面法向；在先验融合层面，利用单一校准的可靠性信号驱动自适应光线选择、可靠性控制的沿射线采样和置信度感知的先验监督。
AI.findings: 在Replica和ScanNet数据集上，ConfSurf的F-score@5cm分别达到93.73%和78.25%，超越最强先验引导基线5.68和6.45个百分点；训练仅需单张RTX 3090上5.2小时。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨模态一致性的统一先验提取框架，解决了任务特定估计器的输出不一致问题；设计了校准可靠性信号驱动的自适应融合机制，克服了空间均匀信任的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了高精度且高效的神经隐式表面重建方法，训练时间短（5.2小时），对基础模型具有框架无关性，易于在实际场景中部署和扩展。

title: Adaptive Density-Aware Soft Clustering Federated Learning Framework with Multi-Source Weighted Aggregation and Hypergraph Enhancement
affiliations: Inner Mongolia University of Science and Technology, Inner Mongolia University of Science and Technology and Inner Mongolia University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Adaptive Density-Aware Soft Clustering Federated Learning Framework with Multi-Source Weighted Aggregation and Hypergraph Enhancement
detail.abstract: Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) mitigates data heterogeneity in Federated Learning (FL) by constructing cluster structures among clients. However, hard clustering methods enforce each client to belong exclusively to a single cluster, making it difficult to capture overlapping similarity structures. Although soft clustering enhances structural expressiveness through multi-membership, existing approaches still suffer from fixed threshold dependency, insufficient utilization of aggregation information, and limited collaborative guidance for overlapping clients. These limitations hinder the joint modeling of intra-cluster heterogeneity and inter-cluster structural relationships. To address these issues, we propose an Adaptive Density-Aware Soft Clustering Federated Learning framework with Multi-Source Information Weighted Aggregation and Hypergraph Enhancement (MIWAHGE-SCFL). The proposed framework models soft clustering relationships as a hypergraph and constructs a density-aware client–hyperedge membership matrix by jointly leveraging model parameters and gradient information, enabling fine-grained characterization of overlapping similarities. Building upon this, a two-level optimization mechanism is developed, consisting of hyperedge-level model aggregation and cross-hyperedge collaborative guidance. At the hyperedge level, a multi-source information weighted aggregation method is proposed, which integrates loss evolution trends, predictive entropy-based confidence, and sample size information to improve aggregation stability and robustness. At the cross-hyperedge level, a hypergraph-enhanced model guidance strategy is introduced for overlapping clients, enabling collaborative optimization from both hyperedge models and highly similar models. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate that MIWAHGE-SCFL achieves superior model performance and generalization capability under complex heterogeneous settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIWAHGE-SCFL框架，通过自适应密度感知软聚类、多源信息加权聚合和超图增强，解决联邦学习中数据异构性和重叠相似性结构建模问题。
AI.research_question: 如何解决联邦学习中硬聚类无法捕捉重叠相似性结构，以及现有软聚类方法存在的固定阈值依赖、聚合信息利用不充分、重叠客户端协作指导不足等问题？
AI.motivation: 现有聚类联邦学习方法中，硬聚类强制每个客户端只属于一个聚类，难以捕捉重叠相似性；软聚类虽有改进，但仍存在阈值固定、聚合信息利用不充分、对重叠客户端的协作指导有限等局限，阻碍了对簇内异质性和簇间结构关系的联合建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软聚类建模为超图结构；密度感知的客户端-超边隶属度矩阵；两层次优化机制（超边级模型聚合与跨超边协作指导）。
AI.method: 将软聚类关系建模为超图，利用模型参数和梯度信息构建密度感知的客户端-超边隶属度矩阵；提出多源信息加权聚合方法（融合损失演化趋势、预测熵置信度、样本量信息）；提出超图增强的模型指导策略，实现重叠客户端的协作优化。
AI.findings: 在多个公共数据集上的实验表明，MIWAHGE-SCFL在复杂异构环境下取得了优越的模型性能和泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将软聚类关系建模为超图的新视角；设计了密度感知的隶属度矩阵构建方法；提出了两层次优化机制，包括超边级多源信息加权聚合和跨超边协作指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联邦学习中的数据异构性问题提供了更精细的聚类建模和聚合方案，提升了模型在复杂异构环境下的性能和泛化能力。

title: Gendered Pathways and Youth Agency in Sustainable Agriculture Entrepreneurship
affiliations: Marondera University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology, Marondera University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Gendered Pathways and Youth Agency in Sustainable Agriculture Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract: 1. AbstractEngaging youth in sustainable agricultural entrepreneurship serves as a strategic route for fostering inclusive development in sub-Saharan Africa. Nevertheless, enduring gender inequalities continue to affect participation, access to opportunities, and the recognition of agency. This study explores how young men and women in Zimbabwe's Marondera District navigate the gendered pathways associated with agripreneurship. The study used an integrated Feminist Political Economy and Structuration Theory framework as guiding theories for the research. The study drew on qualitative interviews with 28 youth agripreneurs (14 women and 14 men) from rural and urban settings. Findings reveal patriarchal land tenure systems, exclusionary financial practices, and unequal distributions of unpaid care and agricultural labour as entrenched barriers. These constraints not only limit material access but also affect cognitive, psychological, and aspirational dimensions of entrepreneurship. Despite these challenges, young women demonstrate strong agency. They engage in collective action, leverage digital platforms, innovate in niche markets, and negotiate household and community relationships. Agency is shown to be relational and strategic, exercised within and against structural constraints. The study reframes entrepreneurial success through a capabilities lens, emphasising autonomy, dignity, and social recognition alongside economic outcomes. It contributes to agrarian gender scholarship by illustrating the dynamic interplay between structure and agency. Policy insights highlight the need for gender-transformative youth entrepreneurship ecosystems aligned with Sustainable Development Goals 5 and 8.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨津巴布韦青年在农业创业中的性别化路径，发现 patriarchal 土地制度、金融排斥和照料劳动不平等构成结构性障碍，但年轻女性通过集体行动、数字平台和创新策略展现出强大的能动性。研究以能力路径重新定义创业成功，强调自主、尊严与社会认可。
AI.research_question: 津巴布韦马龙德拉地区年轻男性和女性如何在农业创业中 navigating 性别化的路径？结构性约束如何影响他们的参与，以及他们如何展现能动性？
AI.motivation: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，青年可持续农业创业被视为促进包容性发展的战略途径，但持续的性别不平等影响了参与、机会获取和能动性认可，亟需深入理解其中的性别化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了女性主义政治经济学（Feminist Political Economy）和结构化理论（Structuration Theory）作为指导框架。
AI.method: 对津巴布韦马龙德拉地区28名青年农业创业者（14名女性，14名男性）进行定性访谈，样本涵盖城乡不同背景。
AI.findings: 1）父权土地制度、金融排斥、无偿照料劳动和农业劳动不平等分配构成根深蒂固的障碍；2）这些约束不仅限制物质获取，还影响创业的认知、心理和志向维度；3）年轻女性展现出强大能动性，包括集体行动、利用数字平台、细分市场创新、协商家庭与社区关系；4）能动性是关系性和策略性的，在结构性约束之内及对抗中行使。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过能力路径重新定义创业成功，强调自主、尊严和社会认可与经济成果并重；为农业性别研究贡献了结构与能动性动态互动的实证洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示强调需要建立符合可持续发展目标5（性别平等）和目标8（体面工作与经济增长）的性别变革型青年创业生态系统。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Nutrition Management: How Data-Driven Tools Can Improve Diet Planning, Patient Support, and Public Health

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in Nutrition Management: How Data-Driven Tools Can Improve Diet Planning, Patient Support, and Public Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that may have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Nutrition management has become increasingly complex because of the growth of diet-related diseases, unequal access to professional dietary support, and the rising demand for personalized care in health systems. Artificial intelligence can enhance the support received by patients and communities by transforming fragmented dietary, clinical, behavioral, and population data into more flexible forms of decision support. This paper develops a qualitative conceptual analysis of artificial intelligence in nutrition management through the lens of stakeholder theory. It argues that the value of data-driven nutrition tools depends not only on technical performance, but also on their ability to address the needs of patients, dietitians, clinicians, health services, public health authorities, and affected communities. The paper identifies three main areas of contribution: personalized diet planning, continuous patient engagement, and the integration of nutrition data for public health decision-making. It also examines important weaknesses, including the possible loss of professional judgment, poor or over-standardized dietary advice, algorithmic bias, and weak data governance. The paper argues that artificial intelligence can strengthen nutrition management when it supports human expertise rather than replaces it. Responsible implementation requires culturally responsive design, transparent governance, professional oversight, and diverse models of collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过利益相关者理论视角，对人工智能在营养管理中的应用进行了定性概念分析，探讨了其在个性化饮食规划、患者持续参与和公共卫生决策整合方面的贡献，同时指出了算法偏见、专业判断丧失等风险，主张AI应当增强而非取代人类专业判断。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何在营养管理中发挥作用？其价值不仅取决于技术性能，还取决于能否满足多方利益相关者（患者、营养师、临床医生、卫生服务、公共卫生机构和受影响社区）的需求。
AI.motivation: 营养管理因饮食相关疾病增多、专业饮食支持获取不平等及个性化护理需求上升而日益复杂，需要借助AI将碎片化数据转化为灵活决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论（Stakeholder Theory）
AI.method: 定性概念分析
AI.findings: 三个主要贡献领域：个性化饮食规划、持续患者参与、营养数据整合用于公共卫生决策；主要弱点包括：专业判断丧失、膳食建议过于标准化或质量低下、算法偏见、数据治理薄弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI在营养管理中的价值应基于利益相关者理论进行多维评估，而非仅关注技术性能；强调AI应增强而非替代人类专业判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 负责任实施需要文化适应性设计、透明治理、专业监督和多元化协作模式。

title: Track-Guided Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Drifting with Minimum-Lap-Time Planning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Nanyang Technological University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Track-Guided Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Drifting with Minimum-Lap-Time Planning
detail.abstract: In Formula 1, drivers optimize racing lines within tire grip limits to minimize lap times; however, in rally racing, drivers intentionally break traction to drift on loose surfaces. This maneuver rapidly aligns the vehicle for corner exits, ultimately reducing lap time. Autonomously executing such maneuvers formulates a complex dual-objective control problem: stabilizing highly nonlinear drift dynamics while strictly minimizing lap time. Addressing this challenge motivates the development of advanced Minimum-Lap-Time (MLT) drift control architectures.This paper proposes a planning-control framework specifically designed for MLT drifting scenario. First, we formulate an optimal control problem to generate a MLT drift planning trajectory, which is used as prior data to train a deep reinforcement learning drift controller. Given that drifting involves extremely large sideslip angles and is therefore challenging to learn directly, a Track-guided Reinforcement Learning (TgRL) drift control method is proposed to enable progressive training in a step-by-step manner—from drift control policy, to drift corner policy, and finally to a comprehensive drift race policy.The reward function incorporates both an instant reward term and an end reward term derived from the Minimum-Lap-Time objective. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables the agent to learn a drift racing policy that not only ensures vehicle motion control performance but also effectively reduces lap time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对拉力赛中漂移场景的最小圈时间规划-控制框架，通过最优控制生成漂移轨迹并采用渐进式深度强化学习（TgRL）训练漂移控制器，在保证车辆运动控制性能的同时有效减少圈时。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够自主执行最小圈时间（MLT）漂移的控制架构，在稳定高度非线性的漂移动态的同时严格最小化圈时？
AI.motivation: 在拉力赛中，车手通过故意打破牵引力来漂移以快速调整车辆朝向、减少圈时，但自主执行这一动作为复杂的双目标控制问题（稳定漂移动态 + 最小化圈时），现有控制方法难以兼顾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优控制理论（MLT轨迹规划）、深度强化学习（渐进式训练框架TgRL）、奖励函数设计（即时奖励+基于MLT目标的终局奖励）
AI.method: 1）最优控制问题求解生成MLT漂移规划轨迹；2）将规划轨迹作为先验数据训练深度强化学习漂移控制器；3）提出Track-guided Reinforcement Learning（TgRL）渐进式训练方法，分三个阶段：漂移控制策略→漂移弯道策略→完整漂移比赛策略。
AI.findings: 所提出的框架使智能体学习到的漂移比赛策略既能保证车辆运动控制性能，又能有效减少圈时。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将最优控制规划与深度强化学习渐进式训练相结合的MLT漂移控制框架，为复杂非线性动力学控制问题提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶拉力赛车提供了可行的漂移控制方案，可实际应用于高性能自主驾驶场景中减少圈时。

title: Dynamic Momentum Trading via Deep Q-Networks: An Intelligent Execution Framework for Portfolio Management
affiliations: Hebei Normal University, Hebei Normal University, Toronto Metropolitan University, Hebei Normal University and Toronto Metropolitan University

detail.title: Dynamic Momentum Trading via Deep Q-Networks: An Intelligent Execution Framework for Portfolio Management
detail.abstract: Momentum trading remains one of the most persistent anomalies in financial markets, but its practical implementation faces challenges due to regime shifts, execution uncertainty, and drawdown risk. To address these issues, we propose a Dynamic Momentum Deep Q-Network (DMDQN), an intelligent execution framework that integrates signal extraction, portfolio optimization, and reinforcement learning-based trading decisions. Specifically, DMDQN combines momentum signals with an LSTM-enhanced mean–variance allocation module to construct dynamic portfolios, while a Deep Q-Network is employed to learn optimal execution policies via adaptive rebalancing under changing market conditions. Empirical results from two representative equity markets, China and the United States, show that DMDQN consistently outperforms benchmark strategies, achieving higher average returns and Sharpe ratios with improved drawdown control—performance is further enhanced after incorporating a stop-loss liquidation rule. Ablation studies confirm that each component contributes positively, with the DQN execution module yielding the largest marginal improvement in risk-adjusted performance. Robustness tests across signal types, training protocols, and market environments further demonstrate the strong generalizability of the proposed approach. Moreover, the proposed DMDQN framework effectively reduces the crash risk associated with traditional momentum investing. Overall, DMDQN provides a practical and effective reinforcement learning-based framework for dynamic momentum trading and intelligent portfolio execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的动态动量交易框架（DMDQN），结合动量信号提取、LSTM增强的均值-方差投资组合优化和深度Q网络执行策略，在中美股市中显著优于传统基准策略，有效提升了收益、夏普比率和回撤控制，并降低了动量策略的崩盘风险。
AI.research_question: 如何通过深度强化学习解决动量交易中存在的市场制度转换、执行不确定性和回撤风险问题？
AI.motivation: 动量交易是金融市场中最持久的异象之一，但其实际执行面临市场制度转换、执行不确定性和大幅回撤等挑战，现有方法缺乏能够动态适应市场变化的智能执行框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动量策略理论、均值-方差投资组合优化、LSTM深度学习、深度Q网络（DQN）强化学习、信号提取与智能执行框架。
AI.method: 提出DMDQN框架，将动量信号提取与LSTM增强的均值-方差配置模块结合构建动态投资组合，再通过深度Q网络学习自适应再平衡的最优执行策略。在中国和美国两个代表性股票市场进行实证检验，并进行消融实验和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: DMDQN在中美股市中均持续优于基准策略，获得更高的平均收益和夏普比率，并显著改善回撤控制；加入止损清仓规则后表现进一步提升。消融实验表明各组件均有正向贡献，其中DQN执行模块对风险调整后收益的边际提升最大。DMDQN有效降低了传统动量投资的崩盘风险，且在不同信号类型、训练协议和市场环境下均具有较强的泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信号提取、投资组合优化与深度强化学习执行整合为统一的动态动量交易框架，为动量策略的智能执行提供了新范式；揭示了DQN执行模块在风险调整收益中的核心作用，深化了对强化学习在金融交易中应用机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为动量交易提供了可落地的智能化执行方案，能够有效降低回撤和崩盘风险，提升策略的稳健性和实际可行性；在中美两大市场均验证了有效性，具有较强的跨市场泛化能力，对量化投资和资产管理实践具有直接参考价值。

title: The K-Threshold Volunteer's Dilemma on Networks
affiliations: University of Galway

detail.title: The K-Threshold Volunteer's Dilemma on Networks
detail.abstract: The classical Volunteer's Dilemma (VD) assumes that a single volunteer is sufficient to provide a collective benefit to all participants. However, many real collective-action problems have a threshold structure, i.e., a minimum number of contributors that is required before any benefit is achieved for the members of the group. We study this K-threshold VD on both regular and Erdos-Renyi networks under evolutionary Fermi imitation. We vary the threshold $\kappa$ and record the volunteering rate, the provision probability, and any over-contribution.We report three main findings. Firstly, on $d$-regular graphs the volunteering rate rises monotonically with increasing threshold but the provision probability falls; there is no evidence of a phase transition between K = 1 and K = 2.Secondly, on Erdos-Renyi graphs, at matched mean degree k, the provision is uniformly lower than on regular graphs, but the degree-stratified volunteering rate is essentially flat: under uniform cost, strategies don't vary across degree classes even when payoffs depend on local degree. Thirdly, when the cost is made dependent on the degree, the volunteering rate falls monotonically with increasing cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究K阈值志愿者困境博弈在规则图和ER图上的演化动态，发现阈值提高会提升志愿率但降低供给概率，且规则图上的供给概率优于ER图。
AI.research_question: 在K阈值志愿者困境博弈中，网络结构（规则图与ER图）和阈值大小如何影响个体的志愿行为、公共品供给概率以及过度贡献现象？
AI.motivation: 经典的志愿者困境假设一个人即可提供公共品，但现实中的集体行动往往需要达到最低贡献人数阈值（如罢工、环保行动），因此需要研究多阈值情境下的合作演化。
AI.theoretical_framework: K阈值志愿者困境博弈、演化博弈论、费米更新规则、网络博弈理论。
AI.method: 采用演化费米模仿动力学，在d-规则图和Erdos-Renyi随机图上进行模拟分析，变化阈值K，记录志愿率、供给概率和过度贡献。
AI.findings: （1）d-规则图上，志愿率随阈值单调上升，但供给概率下降；K=1到K=2未发现相变。（2）ER图上，同等平均度下供给概率低于规则图，且分层志愿率基本平坦——均匀成本下策略不随度类变化。（3）成本与度关联时，志愿率随成本增加单调下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典志愿者困境拓展至多阈值情境，揭示了网络拓扑（规则vs随机）对集体行动动态的系统性影响，发现均匀成本下度异质性对策略无显著影响这一反直觉结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计促进集体行动的制度（如阈值设定、成本分摊机制）提供理论依据，提示在高度异质性网络中需谨慎调整成本结构以激励参与。

title: Deep Learning and Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Accurate Short-Term Photovoltaic Energy Forecasting​
affiliations: Tekirdag Namik Kemal University, Trakya University and Trakya University

detail.title: Deep Learning and Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Accurate Short-Term Photovoltaic Energy Forecasting​
detail.abstract: This study investigates the predictive performance and interpretability of a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model in comparison with conventional machine learning approaches, namely Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and Random Forest (RF), for short-term photovoltaic (PV) energy forecasting. Using a high-resolution time-series dataset comprising 9,854 observations from a single PV system, the study addresses the challenge of accurately modeling highly stochastic solar energy generation while enhancing model transparency. The results demonstrate that LSTM outperforms the benchmark models, achieving the highest accuracy (R² = 0.65, RMSE ≈ 2.00, MAE ≈ 1.04), whereas XGBoost (R² ≈ 0.58) and RF (R² ≈ 0.41) exhibit comparatively lower performance, highlighting the limitations of tree-based methods in capturing temporal dependencies. Model interpretability is examined using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), which identify global solar irradiance and trigonometric temporal features (day_sin, hour_cos) as the dominant drivers of PV output. Furthermore, SHAP interaction analysis reveals a physically consistent relationship between irradiance and temperature, indicating that the positive contribution of solar radiation becomes more pronounced under elevated temperature conditions. The findings demonstrate that integrating deep learning with explainable artificial intelligence provides not only improved predictive accuracy but also enhanced transparency, addressing a critical barrier to the practical deployment of data-driven PV forecasting models.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了LSTM与XGBoost、随机森林在短期光伏发电预测中的表现，发现LSTM预测精度最高（R²=0.65），并通过SHAP方法揭示了太阳辐射和时间特征是光伏输出的主要驱动因素，验证了深度学习与可解释AI结合在提升预测精度和模型透明度方面的价值。
AI.research_question: LSTM模型在短期光伏发电预测中的性能是否优于传统机器学习方法（XGBoost、随机森林），以及如何通过可解释性技术提升模型透明度？
AI.motivation: 光伏发电具有高度随机性，准确预测对电网稳定性至关重要，但深度学习模型的"黑箱"特性限制了其实际应用。本研究旨在解决预测精度与模型可解释性之间的权衡问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: LSTM（长短期记忆网络）用于捕捉时间序列依赖关系；SHAP（Shapley加法解释）用于模型可解释性分析。
AI.method: 使用包含9,854条高分辨率时间序列数据的单个光伏系统数据集，对比LSTM、XGBoost和随机森林三种模型的预测性能，并采用SHAP进行特征重要性和交互效应分析。
AI.findings: LSTM表现最优（R²=0.65, RMSE≈2.00, MAE≈1.04），优于XGBoost（R²≈0.58）和随机森林（R²≈0.41）。SHAP分析显示全球太阳辐射和三角函数时间特征（day_sin, hour_cos）是主要驱动因素；辐照度与温度的交互效应符合物理规律，即在高温条件下太阳辐射的正贡献更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了深度学习模型（LSTM）在捕捉时间依赖性方面优于树模型，为时间序列预测领域提供了方法比较证据；将SHAP可解释性框架应用于光伏预测，揭示了关键驱动因素及其物理一致性交互效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为光伏发电预测实践提供了模型选择建议（LSTM优于XGBoost和随机森林）；通过可解释性分析增强了模型透明度，有助于推动数据驱动预测模型在电力系统中的实际部署。

title: Analysing Moral Bias in Finetuned LLMs through Mechanistic Interpretability
affiliations: University of Bologna, University of Bologna and University of Bologna

detail.title: Analysing Moral Bias in Finetuned LLMs through Mechanistic Interpretability
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to internalize human-like biases during finetuning, yet the mechanisms by which these biases manifest remain unclear. In this work, we investigated whether the well-known Knobe effect, a moral bias in intentionality judgements, emerges in finetuned LLMs and whether it can be traced back to specific components of the model. We conducted a Layer-Patching analysis across 3 open-weights LLMs and demonstrated that the bias is not only learned during finetuning but also localized in a specific set of layers. Surprisingly, we found that patching activations from the corresponding pretrained model into just a critical layer is sufficient to eliminate the effect. Our findings indicate that social biases in LLMs can be interpreted, localized, and mitigated through targeted interventions, without the need for model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型在微调后能够习得Knobe效应（一种道德偏见），且该偏见被定位到模型中的特定层。通过仅修复关键层的激活值，即可消除这种偏见，无需重新训练模型。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在微调后是否会习得Knobe效应（道德偏见）？这种偏见能否被定位到模型的具体组件？
AI.motivation: 尽管已知大语言模型在微调过程中会内化人类类似偏见，但偏见产生的机制尚不清楚。揭示偏见定位机制有助于实现可控的模型干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: Knobe效应（道德偏见理论）；Layer-Patching分析（层激活干预方法）
AI.method: 对3个开源大语言模型进行Layer-Patching分析，将微调后模型的特定层激活值替换为预训练模型的对应层激活值，观察Knobe效应是否消除。
AI.findings: Knobe效应在微调后被习得，且集中在少数特定层；仅修复关键层的激活值即可消除该效应，无需重新训练。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会偏见在大语言模型中的可定位性，证明微调带来的偏见可以追溯到具体层，支持了模型内部表征的可解释性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需重新训练即可消除模型偏见的轻量级方法，为LLM伦理对齐和偏见缓解提供了实际可行的干预策略。

title: SFAPose: Cross-Species Animal Pose Estimation via Flow-Field Alignment and Species-Aware Text Priors
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chengdu University, Guizhou University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Guizhou University

detail.title: SFAPose: Cross-Species Animal Pose Estimation via Flow-Field Alignment and Species-Aware Text Priors
detail.abstract: To tackle the challenges of semantic ambiguity and cross-scale localization drift stemming from cross-species appearance variations and diverse poses in animal pose estimation, we propose SFAPose, a cross-scale multi-modal fusion network. Specifically, we first introduce the GCSA module into the backbone to effectively suppress noise and enhance key anatomical features via a joint attention mechanism. Subsequently, we propose the KAFAusionNeck, which utilizes a learnable pixel-wise displacement field to perform geometric correction on multi-scale features and achieves precise fusion through keypoint-wise weighting. Finally, we construct the SPALHead to incorporate strong priors at the semantic level, thereby mitigating ambiguities arising from long-tail species and appearance discrepancies. Extensive experiments on the AP-10K and AnimalPose benchmarks demonstrate that SFAPose outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Notably, on the AP-10K test set, it improves the baseline AP by 2.2\% and surpasses CLAMP and HRFormer by 1.5\% and 1.8\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFAPose，一种用于动物姿态估计的跨尺度多模态融合网络，通过GCSA模块、KAFAusionNeck和SPALHead三个核心创新，有效解决了跨物种外观差异和多样姿态带来的语义模糊与跨尺度定位漂移问题，在AP-10K和AnimalPose基准上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.research_question: 如何解决动物姿态估计中因跨物种外观变化和多样姿态导致的语义模糊与跨尺度定位漂移问题？
AI.motivation: 现有动物姿态估计方法在处理跨物种外观差异（如长尾物种）和复杂姿态时，存在语义模糊和跨尺度定位漂移的挑战，亟需一种更鲁棒的跨尺度多模态融合方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨尺度多模态融合；联合注意力机制；可学习像素级位移场；关键点加权融合；语义级先验嵌入
AI.method: 1) GCSA模块：通过联合注意力机制抑制噪声、增强关键解剖特征；2) KAFAusionNeck：利用可学习像素级位移场对多尺度特征进行几何校正，并通过关键点加权实现精确融合；3) SPALHead：在语义层面融入强先验，缓解长尾物种和外观差异带来的歧义。
AI.findings: 在AP-10K和AnimalPose基准上，SFAPose超越现有SOTA方法；在AP-10K测试集上，AP比基线提升2.2%，分别超越CLAMP和HRFormer 1.5%和1.8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出GCSA模块，将联合注意力机制引入动物姿态估计骨干网络；2) 提出KAFAusionNeck，创新性地将可学习像素级位移场用于多尺度特征的几何校正与关键点加权融合；3) 提出SPALHead，将语义级强先验引入头部网络以解决长尾歧义问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为动物姿态估计任务提供了一种有效的跨尺度多模态融合框架，显著提升了复杂场景下的定位精度，对动物行为分析、生态保护等实际应用具有重要价值。

title: Virtual Photon Pre-Emission -Part II: Extended Framework for Optical Pumping, Spin Tunneling, and the Magnetic Trigger Test

detail.title: Virtual Photon Pre-Emission -Part II: Extended Framework for Optical Pumping, Spin Tunneling, and the Magnetic Trigger Test
detail.abstract: This paper constitutes Part II of the Virtual Photon Pre-Emission framework, extending the core hypothesis introduced in Part I (Danish, 2025; SSRN: 6751086). Part I established that apparent negative tunneling time in Rubidium BEC experiments arises from the detection of pre-emitted virtual photons transitioning from the force-mediating invisible zone into the detectable visible zone at the medium boundaryrestoring causality without invoking superluminal travel or negative time. The present paper extends this framework in three directions. First, we apply the virtual photon pre-emission model to optical pumping, demonstrating that the dense virtual photon field generated during spin polarization predicts a measurable enhancement of early-arrival signals in pumped versus unpumped BEC samples. Second, we reinterpret spin tunneling as the observable conclusion of a virtual photon field reorganization that precedes the classical spin transitioneliminating the need for instantaneous or superluminal mechanisms. Third, and most critically, we propose three directly falsifiable experiments, culminating in the Magnetic Trigger Test: a novel experimental design in which a pulsed superconducting electromagnetwith no laser source presentshould produce detectable photon signals at the exit boundary of a Rb BEC cloud by driving virtual photons from the invisible to the visible zone. Each proposed experiment generates predictions clearly distinguishable from those of standard quantum optical interpretation. Together, these extensions transform the virtual photon pre-emission hypothesis from a qualitative reinterpretation into a testable, falsifiable physical framework.

AI.tldr: 本文是虚拟光子预发射框架的第二部分，将该假说从定性解释发展为可检验的物理框架，提出了三个可直接证伪的实验，包括无激光源的磁性触发测试，以验证虚拟光子在BEC边界处从不可见区转变为可见区的假说。
AI.research_question: 如何将虚拟光子预发射假说从定性解释发展为可检验、可证伪的物理框架，并通过实验验证其预测？
AI.motivation: 第一部分已建立虚拟光子预发射假说以解释铷BEC实验中的负隧穿时间问题，但该假说仍停留在定性层面，亟需通过可检验的实验设计将其转化为严格的物理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虚拟光子预发射框架：力中介不可见区的虚光子在介质边界转变为可探测的可见区光子，以此恢复因果性，无需超光速或负时间机制。
AI.method: 理论扩展与实验设计：(1)将模型应用于光泵浦过程；(2)重新解释自旋隧穿为虚光子场重组；(3)提出三个可直接证伪实验，核心为无激光源的磁性触发测试。
AI.findings: 光泵浦产生的密集虚光子场可预测泵浦与未泵浦BEC样本间早期到达信号的差异；自旋隧穿可被解释为虚光子场在经典自旋转变前的重组过程；磁性触发实验为无激光源驱动虚光子跨越可见与不可见区边界提供了检验方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将虚拟光子预发射从定性假说提升为可检验、可证伪的严格物理框架，为量子隧穿时间问题提供了无需超光速或负时间的因果性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三个可直接实施的实验方案，特别是磁性触发测试，为实验物理学家提供了明确的验证路径。

title: Is There an Equity Greenium in the Euro Area?
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Is There an Equity Greenium in the Euro Area?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy: Markets, Infrastructures, Payment Systems No. 66
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the risk-return profile of sustainable equity investment strategies in the euro area in order to assess the presence of a return differential compared to the market index (equity greenium). The equity greenium includes a component related to financial risk (risk premium) and a component associated with investors’ possible preference for ESG themes (preference premium). We find that the returns on sustainable investments diverge from market returns; this result is due to the different exposure to financial risk factors (risk premium), and not to the preference premium. Going forward, the emergence of certain risks not fully priced in and changes in investor preferences could lead to price adjustments and new market equilibria. This suggests the need for close monitoring of the relationship between sustainable investment strategies and the traditional ones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧元区可持续股权投资策略的风险收益特征，发现其与市场指数存在回报差异，这一差异源于财务风险因素暴露不同（风险溢价），而非投资者对ESG主题的偏好溢价。
AI.research_question: 欧元区可持续股权投资策略是否存在与市场指数之间的回报差异（即"权益绿色溢价"）？该差异是由风险溢价还是偏好溢价驱动的？
AI.motivation: 可持续投资规模快速增长，但其风险收益特征与传统投资策略是否存在系统性差异尚不明确，特别是"绿色溢价"的来源（风险因素还是投资者偏好）有待实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权益绿色溢价（equity greenium）的两成分分解框架：风险溢价（与财务风险因素相关的回报差异）与偏好溢价（投资者对ESG主题的偏好带来的回报差异）。
AI.method: 实证分析，比较欧元区可持续股权投资策略与市场指数的收益表现，通过风险因子模型分解回报差异的来源。
AI.findings: 可持续投资回报与市场回报存在差异；该差异源于对财务风险因子的不同暴露（风险溢价），而非偏好溢价。未来尚未完全定价的风险和投资者偏好变化可能导致价格调整和新市场均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了可持续投资与传统投资的回报差异主要来源于风险溢价而非偏好溢价，丰富了绿色金融领域的资产定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示投资者和监管机构需密切监测可持续投资策略与传统策略之间的关系，关注未来风险重定价和偏好变化带来的市场调整。

reference: Bank of Italy: Markets, Infrastructures, Payment Systems No. 69
title: A Solution for Cross-Border and Cross-Currency Interoperability of Instant Payment Systems
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: A Solution for Cross-Border and Cross-Currency Interoperability of Instant Payment Systems

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy: Markets, Infrastructures, Payment Systems No. 69
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Instant Payment Systems (IPSs) enable real-time settlement of transactions, providing immediate confirmation of payment status to both parties. However, these systems are predominantly tailored to domestic use and typically operate within specific jurisdictions. Consequently, their capacity to support cross-border and cross-currency transactions is limited.This paper proposes a novel approach for interconnecting IPSs to facilitate cross-border and cross-currency payments, effectively extending these functionalities as an overlay to existing domestic systems. The proposed model introduces a standardized protocol that enables the synchronous processing of instant payments across different IPSs, thereby preserving the immediacy and user experience that are typical of domestic instant payments, even in international contexts. 
Crucially, the proposed interlinking model avoids relying on a centralized hub, which would require designating a central institution to build and manage shared infrastructure. Instead, we advocate using a decentralized approach which, through the adoption of a standardized protocol and the development of an adapter—or gateway—capable of translating and routing messages, allows different IPSs to interoperate directly. This decentralized approach leverages existing bilateral connections between IPSs, repurposing them to form a network of autonomous yet interoperable systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种去中心化的标准化协议，通过构建适配器/网关，使不同司法管辖区的即时支付系统（IPS）能够互联互通，实现跨境、跨币种的实时支付，且无需依赖中心化枢纽机构。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种去中心化的互联方案，使现有的国内即时支付系统能够支持跨境和跨币种交易，同时保持即时性和良好的用户体验？
AI.motivation: 现有即时支付系统（IPS）主要面向国内使用，局限于特定司法管辖区，缺乏支持跨境和跨币种交易的能力。因此，需要一种新的互联方案来扩展其功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去中心化互联模型；标准化协议；适配器/网关架构；点对点双边连接网络。
AI.method: 本文提出一种去中心化的互联模型，通过设计标准化协议和开发能够翻译和路由消息的适配器（网关），使不同的IPS之间可以直接互通，利用现有的双边连接形成自治且可互操作的系统网络。
AI.findings: 提出的去中心化互联模型能够在不需要中心化枢纽机构的情况下，实现不同IPS之间的同步处理即时支付，保持国内即时支付的即时性和用户体验。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种去中心化的IPS互联理论模型，摒弃了传统中心化枢纽方案，为跨境支付系统互操作提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同国家和地区的即时支付系统实现跨境、跨币种支付提供了可行的技术路径，有助于降低跨境支付成本、提高效率，并改善用户在国际支付场景中的体验。
