It develops an evidence architecture for a 2022-2025 district-year framework that links three channels: technological diffusion gaps, intermediation margins, and compliance-related barriers in premium export markets. Using observed 2022 district production rows together with harmonized 2020-2025 trade evidence, the analysis clarifies variable construction, reports data-readiness constraints, motivates testable hypotheses, and sets out an empirical design for later estimation as additional official observations are incorporated [3, 2]. It does not estimate causal effects; instead, it defines the auditable data architecture required for later causal and margin-decomposition work. The paper argues that production dominance alone is unlikely to translate into broad producer gains unless institutional access, processing recovery, and market intermediation are jointly addressed.

AI.tldr: 本文为比哈尔邦makhana经济构建了一个2022-2025年区级证据架构，通过技术扩散差距、中介利润和出口合规壁垒三个渠道，分析为何占全球产量80-85%的主产区生产者只获得有限价值份额，为后续因果估计和利润分解奠定数据基础。
AI.research_question: 为什么比哈尔邦贡献全球makhana产量的80-85%，但初级生产者仅捕获有限的下游价值？
AI.motivation: 揭示生产主导型农业经济中生产者价值捕获不足的结构性矛盾，为政策干预提供可审计的证据基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值捕获理论、农业价值链分析、市场中介理论、技术扩散理论
AI.method: 基于2022-2025年区级面板数据框架，构建技术扩散差距、中介利润、出口合规壁垒三个渠道的证据架构；使用2022年区级生产数据和2020-2025年协调贸易数据进行变量构建和数据就绪性评估。
AI.findings: 生产主导优势本身不足以转化为广泛的生产者收益，需要同时解决制度性准入、加工回收率和市场中介问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业价值链分析提供了生产集中度与价值捕获不对称的系统性证据架构，将技术扩散、市场中介和制度合规整合为统一的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比哈尔邦makhana产业政策制定提供了可审计的数据基础和分析架构，明确了生产者收益提升需要同时关注制度准入、加工能力和市场中介三个维度。

title: The Sovereign Wall: A Multi-Dimensional Strategy for Countering Deltaic Recession and Saline Intrusion in Pakistan

detail.title: The Sovereign Wall: A Multi-Dimensional Strategy for Countering Deltaic Recession and Saline Intrusion in Pakistan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted as an independent policy analysis exercise without any institutional, commercial, political, or extremist affiliation. No external funding was received from any government, political party, pressure group, or private entity. Neutrality of critique: This paper examines historical water‑management treaties (including the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty, the 1991 Water Accord, and the role of the World Bank) and various Pakistani water institutions (IRSA, WAPDA, etc.) from a strictly analytical and evidence‑based perspective. Any criticism of past policies, accords, or entities is not intended to target, blame, or defame any specific government, country, organisation, or political ideology. Rather, it is aimed at objectively identifying structural weaknesses, unintended consequences, and missed opportunities in order to prevent similar mistakes in the future and to inform better policy design. The author holds no personal or political grievance against any state, institution, or individual mentioned. Purpose statement: The sole purpose of this paper is to provide a strategic, evidence‑based framework to empower future researchers, policymakers, engineers, and environmental practitioners working on the Indus Delta, to promote sustainable water management, to support the growth of Pakistan’s blue economy, and to safeguard the region’s ecological and economic future. The author has no personal or political agenda other than the academic pursuit of knowledge and the long‑term well‑being of the deltaic communities and ecosystems. AI disclosure: This paper was prepared with the assistance of an AI language model. The author personally conceived the research question, developed the core argument, designed the methodological framework (including the “Policy‑Defense Gap” model), performed the literature synthesis, formulated the engineering proposals (MAR, composite sluice networks, silt‑redirect, green wall), and wrote the initial complete draft. The AI was used as a writing and editing aid to refine language, improve clarity, and assist with formatting and citation verification. All intellectual content, strategic insights, and conclusions remain the sole work of the author. The AI tool is not an author and bears no responsibility for the accuracy or originality of the work. Its use is disclosed for full transparency.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects. It is a conceptual policy paper based entirely on publicly available secondary sources (peer‑reviewed literature, government reports, news articles, and international organization databases). Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not‑for‑profit sectors. The author completed the work as an independent researcher without financial support.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This research does not involve any clinical trial.

detail.abstract: The Indus Delta's collapse constitutes a critical sovereign threat, where the permanent forfeiture of coastal territory to saline intrusion violates Pakistan's territorial integrity and catalyzes internal instability through climate-induced migration. The Jinnah Institute estimates that over 1.2 million people have been displaced from the Indus Delta region in the last two decades, while freshwater flow into the delta has decreased by approximately 80 per cent since the 1950s. Despite chronic failures of surface-water governance, national policy remains largely confined to zero-sum inter-provincial water sharing. This paper argues that the prevailing 'surface-water obsession' reflects a systemic marginalization of the coastal periphery and a significant knowledge gap regarding subterranean hydro-dynamics, treating territorial loss as an unavoidable natural phenomenon rather than a remediable strategic failure. This study employs a policy analysis framework, drawing on peer-reviewed literature, satellite remote sensing data, international climate assessments, and macroeconomic reports to document the divergence between official policy narratives and the geo-chemical reality of land forfeiture. Based on this analysis, the paper concludes that transitioning to decentralized subterranean defense-specifically managed aquifer recharge and composite sluice networks-offers a strategically viable path for a fiscally constrained state. By bypassing negative-sum surface-water politics, this model provides a high-return defense that could preserve the sovereign food basket and reduce economic losses from delta degradation. Ultimately, this strategic pivot secures the vulnerable southern frontier while helping to stabilize internal migration patterns directed toward the already over-congested Karachi metropolitan area.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印度河三角洲的坍塌对巴基斯坦构成主权威胁，批评现行"地表水迷恋"政策忽视了地下水资源管理，主张通过分散式地下水防御（管理型含水层补给和复合水闸网络）来应对盐水入侵和领土流失，从而保障国家粮食安全并缓解气候移民压力。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦印度河三角洲面临盐水入侵和领土流失的战略威胁，现行政策为何失效，以及如何通过地下水资源管理实现主权防御？
AI.motivation: 印度河三角洲因淡水流量骤减（自1950年代以来减少约80%）导致严重盐水入侵和领土流失，已造成120多万人流离失所，但国家政策仍局限于零和博弈的省际地表水分配，忽视了地下水资源这一战略防御途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策分析框架；地表水迷恋（surface-water obsession）概念；领土主权与安全理论；地下水动力学与盐水入侵理论。
AI.method: 政策分析，综合采用同行评审文献、卫星遥感数据、国际气候评估报告和宏观经济报告，对比官方政策叙事与领土流失的地球化学现实。
AI.findings: 1）现行地表水政策存在系统性忽视沿海边缘地带的问题，将领土流失视为不可逆的自然现象而非可补救的战略失败；2）分散式地下水防御（管理型含水层补给+复合水闸网络）为财政受限国家提供了高回报的战略可行路径；3）该模式可绕过负和博弈的地表水政治，保护主权粮仓，减少三角洲退化的经济损失，并稳定向卡拉奇大都市区的内部迁移模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"地表水迷恋"这一概念，揭示了政策叙事与地质化学现实之间的系统性脱节，将地下水资源管理提升到主权防御的高度来重新理论化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦及类似财政受限的发展中国家提供了一种可操作的分散式地下水防御方案（管理型含水层补给+复合水闸网络），有望缓解气候移民对超大城市（如卡拉奇）的冲击，并保护国家粮食安全。

title: AI-Driven Decision-Support Systems and Entrepreneurial Cognition. A Systematic Literature Review

detail.title: AI-Driven Decision-Support Systems and Entrepreneurial Cognition. A Systematic Literature Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a systematic literature review based exclusively on publicly available academic literature and did not involve human participants, personal data collection, or experimental procedures. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Background: The integration of artificial intelligence into entrepreneurial decision-making has accelerated rapidly, yet the cognitive mechanisms through which AI decision-support systems reshape entrepreneurial judgment and strategic reasoning under uncertainty remain theoretically underdeveloped. Existing frameworks address either AI capabilities or entrepreneurial cognition in isolation, leaving their interaction insufficiently integrated across disciplines. Objective: This review systematically examines how AI-driven decision-support systems influence entrepreneurial cognition and strategic decision-making across the venture lifecycle. Method: A systematic literature review of 32 peer-reviewed studies published between 2000 and 2026 (including preprints retrieved up to early 2026) was conducted using Elicit and Semantic Scholar, drawing from entrepreneurship, cognitive psychology, behavioral economics, and human–AI interaction scholarship; thematic synthesis was employed to identify convergent and contested findings. Results: Six cross-cutting themes were identified: automation bias and uncritical AI deference; cognitive augmentation and bounded rationality mitigation; algorithmic bias and epistemic opacity; human–AI complementarity and the structural limits of full autonomy; AI-mediated transformation of opportunity recognition; and trust calibration, explainability, and governance. Synthesizing these themes, this review proposes the AICE Framework (AI-Influenced Cognitive Entrepreneurship Framework), which maps AI decision-support interactions across three venture stages (ideation, launch, and scaling) as a four-column matrix (AI inputs, cognitive processes affected, decision outputs, and risk signals) with a vertical moderating factors bar running across all three venture stages, encompassing AI literacy, entrepreneur experience, and institutional context. Conclusion: AI decision-support systems function as cognitive intermediaries rather than autonomous decision agents, producing augmentation and distortion effects simultaneously depending on individual and contextual moderators. Future research should prioritize longitudinal and experimental designs to trace how sustained AI reliance reshapes entrepreneurial cognition over time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统综述32篇研究，提出AICE框架（AI影响认知创业框架），揭示AI决策支持系统在创业三阶段（构思、启动、扩张）中作为"认知中介"的双刃剑效应——既增强认知又引发偏差，并受到AI素养、经验与制度环境的调节。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的决策支持系统如何影响创业者的认知机制与战略决策，贯穿创业生命周期的不同阶段？
AI.motivation: 现有文献要么聚焦AI技术能力，要么关注创业认知，缺乏跨学科整合的理论框架来解释AI与创业决策之间的交互机制，尤其是在不确定性环境下AI如何重塑创业者的判断与战略推理。
AI.theoretical_framework: AICE框架（AI-Influenced Cognitive Entrepreneurship Framework）：以三阶段（构思、启动、扩张）× 四列矩阵（AI输入、受影响认知过程、决策输出、风险信号）为主体，配以贯穿全阶段的垂直调节变量条（AI素养、创业者经验、制度环境）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述：检索2000-2026年间32篇同行评审研究，使用Elicit和Semantic Scholar数据库，覆盖创业学、认知心理学、行为经济学和人机交互领域；采用主题综合法识别收敛与争议性发现。
AI.findings: 六大跨主题发现：自动化偏差与盲目遵从、认知增强与有限理性缓解、算法偏见与认识论不透明、人机互补与完全自主的结构性限制、AI中介的机会识别转型、信任校准/可解释性与治理。核心结论：AI是"认知中介"而非自主决策主体，同时产生增强与扭曲效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AICE框架，整合认知心理学与AI决策支持理论，填补了AI能力与创业认知之间的跨学科理论空白；揭示了AI作为"认知中介"的双重效应（增强+扭曲），为创业认知理论增添了技术中介维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了如何审慎使用AI决策支持的指南（注意自动化偏差、警惕算法偏见）；为政策制定者提供了AI治理与可解释性要求的依据；为AI系统设计者提供了创业场景下信任校准与透明度设计的参考。

title: The Sound of Silence: When to Listen to a Bayesian Persuader Under Costly Information Acquisition in a Supply Chain
affiliations: Universidad Finis Terrae and

detail.title: The Sound of Silence: When to Listen to a Bayesian Persuader Under Costly Information Acquisition in a Supply Chain

declarations.funderStatement: Kendrick Center for an Ethical Economy (WVU); Center for Free Enterprise (WVU); CONICYT-PCHA/Doctorado Nacional/2016-21161390

detail.abstract: Inspired by supply chain dynamics, where a firm downstream holds superior demand information over a firm upstream, we study strategic information disclosure and acquisition in decision-making environments where agents exhibit rational inattention. We analyze how asymmetric forecast information affects optimal disclosure policies in a binary-action setting. We characterize the sender-optimal disclosure policy in closed form and show that, under this policy, the rationally inattentive upstream firm optimally acquires no private information on the equilibrium path.

AI.tldr: 本文受供应链动态启发，研究下游企业拥有优于上游企业的需求信息时，理性疏忽代理人的战略性信息披露与获取问题。分析非对称预测信息对二元行动场景中最优披露策略的影响，给出了发送者最优披露策略的闭式解，并证明在该策略下，理性疏忽的上游企业均衡时不获取任何私人信息。
AI.research_question: 在理性疏忽框架下，拥有信息优势的下游企业如何设计最优信息披露策略，以及该策略如何影响上游企业的信息获取决策？
AI.motivation: 受供应链中下游企业通常比上游企业掌握更准确的需求信息这一现实现象启发，研究信息不对称环境下的最优信息披露策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性疏忽理论（Rational Inattention Theory）、信号博弈与信息披露理论。
AI.method: 建立二元行动博弈模型，分析理性疏忽代理人的信息披露与获取策略，推导发送者最优披露策略的闭式解。
AI.findings: 给出了发送者最优披露策略的闭式解；在该最优策略下，理性疏忽的上游企业均衡时不会主动获取任何私人信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 将理性疏忽理论引入供应链信息不对称研究，刻画了最优信息披露策略如何抑制下游企业的信息获取动机，丰富了信息披露与理性疏忽交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应链中下游企业如何设计信息披露机制以协调上下游决策、减少信息获取成本提供了理论指导。

title: From Tax Minimization to Tax Governance: Financial Reporting Quality under IFRS and U.S. GAAP in Multinational SMEs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Tax Minimization to Tax Governance: Financial Reporting Quality under IFRS and U.S. GAAP in Multinational SMEs
detail.abstract: International tax environments have become increasingly complex for multinational small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) operating across diverse regulatory and accounting regimes. In this context, financial reporting quality plays a central role in shaping tax governance, compliance consistency, and risk management. This paper develops a conceptual comparative analysis of how accounting choices under IFRS and U.S. GAAP influence tax timing, cash flow predictability, and the credibility of reported tax positions. Focusing on deferred taxes, revenue recognition, foreign currency translation, leasing arrangements, and financial instruments, the study links accounting measurement decisions to tax risk exposure and governance outcomes. Adopting a practitioner-oriented and applied perspective, the analysis demonstrates how high-quality financial reporting functions as a governance mechanism that strengthens compliance, enhances transparency, and reduces regulatory uncertainty in multinational settings. By reframing international tax planning as a governance challenge rather than an optimization problem, the paper contributes to the literature on international accounting and applied tax governance, offering a conceptual framework that is directly actionable for practitioners, regulators, and standard setters operating in multinational environments.

AI.tldr: 本文基于IFRS与美国GAAP的会计选择差异，从概念上比较分析了财务报告质量如何影响跨国中小企业的税务治理、合规一致性与风险管理，提出高质量财务报告是一种治理机制而非单纯的优化工具。
AI.research_question: 在跨国中小企业面临复杂国际税收环境的背景下，IFRS与美国GAAP下的会计选择如何影响税务时间安排、现金流可预测性以及税务头寸的可信度？
AI.motivation: 跨国中小企业的国际税收环境日益复杂，但现有文献较少从财务报告质量与税务治理的交叉视角出发，系统分析会计准则选择如何影响税务风险暴露与治理结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将国际税务规划重新定义为治理挑战而非优化问题，强调财务报告质量作为治理机制的理论定位。
AI.method: 概念性比较分析（Conceptual Comparative Analysis），聚焦于递延税项、收入确认、外币折算、租赁安排和金融工具五个领域。
AI.findings: 高质量财务报告能够作为治理机制，增强合规性、提升透明度、减少跨国经营中的监管不确定性；IFRS与GAAP的差异显著影响税务时间安排与现金流可预测性。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了国际税务规划的性质——从优化问题转向治理挑战；建立了会计选择与税务治理之间的理论联系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国中小企业、监管机构和准则制定者提供了可直接操作的概念框架，帮助理解会计准则选择对税务风险的实际影响。

title: Less Engagement, Not Exit: Corporate Venture Capital under U.S. Export Controls
affiliations: National Taiwan University, National Taiwan University and National Central University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Less Engagement, Not Exit: Corporate Venture Capital under U.S. Export Controls
detail.abstract: The U.S. restricts domestic suppliers from exporting advanced technologies to selected Chinese firms through the BIS Entity List. This paper examines the unintended effects of these export controls on corporate venture capital (CVC), exploiting staggered Entity List designations as exogenous policy shocks. While revenue, profitability, and return on assets remain unchanged, affected parent firms reduce new CVC deal activity following the shock without significantly changing total investment amounts. The decline is more pronounced among firms with greater China exposure. Within their pre-existing portfolio relationships, CVC investors become less actively engaged with China-linked startups by reducing lead roles and round size, yet they do not exit these relationships outright, and the China-linked portfolio companies themselves scale back Chinese patent activity post-shock. For new investments made after the shock, affected parents shift toward startups without Chinese patent activity. Overall, export controls reshape both the engagement intensity and the China orientation of CVC-backed entrepreneurial financing.

AI.tldr: 美国通过BIS实体清单限制对华高科技出口，意外地影响了企业风险投资（CVC）行为：受波及的母公司减少了新的CVC交易活动，对中国敞口大的企业影响更显著；虽未完全退出既有投资组合，但对涉及中国的初创企业参与度降低（减少领投角色和投资规模），这些初创企业也减少了中国专利活动；新投资则转向无中国专利的初创企业。出口管制重塑了CVC的参与强度和中国导向。
AI.research_question: 美国对华出口管制（BIS实体清单）如何影响企业风险投资（CVC）活动？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注出口管制对上市公司股价、供应链等直接影响，但对其通过CVC渠道产生的间接、意外影响缺乏研究。CVC是创新融资的重要来源，理解政策外溢效应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策冲击理论、企业投资行为理论、不确定性理论
AI.method: 采用准自然实验方法，利用实体清单指定的交错时间作为外生政策冲击，结合双重差分（DID）模型进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）受影响的母公司营收、盈利能力和资产回报率不变，但减少了新的CVC交易活动，总投资金额无显著变化；（2）对中国敞口越大的企业，CVC下降越明显；（3）对既有投资组合，CVC投资者减少领投角色和投资规模，但不完全退出；（4）涉及中国的被投初创企业减少中国专利活动；（5）受冲击后新投资转向无中国专利的初创企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示出口管制对CVC的意外影响，拓展了政策不确定性与企业投资行为的理论边界；丰富了实体清单政策经济后果的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了出口管制间接效应的实证证据，提示需关注政策对创新融资生态的意外冲击；为企业管理者评估地缘政治风险下的投资策略提供参考。

title: Sprint or Walk? Managing Startup Growth Before Production Capacity Investments
affiliations: , Durham Business School and ESSEC Business School

detail.title: Sprint or Walk? Managing Startup Growth Before Production Capacity Investments
detail.abstract:
Food-tech startups that initially outsource production to contract manufacturers often need to build a sufficiently large base of recurring orders to secure funding for building their own production capacity. However, finding the right speed with which to grow recurring orders requires a delicate balance; growing too fast creates operational challenges and leads to high costs for building the required production capacity, while growing too slowly drains financial resources and may even risk losing the market opportunity. 
To find the right pace of growth, we model a finite-horizon dynamic cost-minimization problem with uncertain sales acquisition, where the startup chooses sales effort in each period to reach a target level of recurring orders. The model incorporates sales effort costs, contract manufacturing costs, and convex capacity-adjustment costs. Reaching the target yields a positive reward. We analyze the structure of the optimal policy. In particular, we derive closed-form solutions for two special cases: deterministic sales acquisition and a single-period model with a two-point distribution of sales acquisition. For the general model, we derive monotonicity properties. We further perform numerical experiments and provide a model extension in which the time window of the market opportunity for the startup is uncertain and can end in every period. 
We find that the optimal growth path balances capacity-adjustment costs with financial losses. When the adjustment costs are more convex, startups should allocate greater sales effort early on. Moreover, because expected losses increase more than proportionally with the target level of recurring orders, founders should carefully assess their operational capabilities before committing to ambitious growth goals. When sales acquisition is uncertain, startups benefit from a more cautious and gradual growth path compared to predictable environments. In contrast, when the timing uncertainty of the market opportunity is high, startups should build sales sooner to secure their market position before the opportunity expires.

AI.tldr: 本文研究食品科技初创企业在从外包生产转向自建产能过程中，如何通过优化销售努力找到最优的经常性订单增长速度，以平衡产能调整成本与财务损失。
AI.research_question: 食品科技初创企业应如何选择经常性订单的增长速度，以在有限时间内从外包生产过渡到自建产能？
AI.motivation: 初创企业增长过快会面临运营挑战和高昂的产能建设成本，增长过慢则会消耗财务资源甚至错失市场机会，因此需要找到适当的增长节奏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限时域动态成本最小化模型，包含销售努力成本、合同制造成本和凸性产能调整成本，并考虑销售获取的不确定性及市场机会窗口的不确定性。
AI.method: 建立有限时域动态优化模型，推导确定性销售获取和单期两分布销售获取两种特例的闭式解，对一般模型推导单调性性质，并进行数值实验和模型扩展（市场机会窗口不确定）。
AI.findings: （1）最优增长路径平衡产能调整成本与财务损失；（2）调整成本越凸，初创企业应越早在销售努力上加大投入；（3）期望损失随经常性订单目标水平超比例增加，创始人应谨慎评估运营能力；（4）销售获取不确定时，应采取更谨慎渐进的增长路径；（5）市场机会时机不确定时，应尽早建立销售以抢占市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 为食品科技初创企业从外包到自建产能的过渡阶段提供了动态优化理论框架，揭示了增长速度与成本结构之间的定量关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为初创企业创始人提供了具体的增长策略指南：根据产能调整成本的凸性、销售获取的不确定性和市场机会窗口的不确定性来调整销售努力的分配和增长节奏。

title: From "I Created This" to "I Love This": How Interactivity and Diversity Drive Continuance Intention in AIGC Customization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From "I Created This" to "I Love This": How Interactivity and Diversity Drive Continuance Intention in AIGC Customization
detail.abstract: While Generative AI (AIGC) is increasingly embedded in mass customization, sustaining engagement beyond initial adoption remains a key challenge. Grounded in Self-Determination Theory, this study examines how two AIGC affordances—interactivity and output diversity—translate into continuance intention through perceived design agency and customization satisfaction. We used a sequential mixed-methods design: a survey of 829 users analyzed via PLS-SEM, followed by semi-structured interviews with 13 participants to interpret a key non-significant direct effect. Results show that both affordances positively predict design agency, satisfaction, and continuance intention. However, design agency does not directly increase continuance; instead, satisfaction fully mediates the agency–continuance link, indicating that psychological empowerment must be converted into positively evaluated process and product outcomes to sustain use. Interviews converge with this mechanism, highlighting iterative control, authorship, and outcome evaluation as drivers of retention.

AI.tldr: 基于自我决定理论，通过829人调查和13人访谈，发现生成式AI的交互性和输出多样性通过设计自主性和定制满意度影响持续使用意愿，其中满意度完全中介了自主性与持续使用意愿的关系。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI（AIGC）的两种可供性（交互性、输出多样性）如何通过感知设计自主性和定制满意度影响用户的持续使用意愿？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已广泛应用于大规模定制，但用户在使用后的持续参与（而非仅仅初始采纳）仍是一个关键挑战，需要深入理解其心理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论（Self-Determination Theory）
AI.method: 顺序混合方法设计：第一阶段对829名用户进行问卷调查，采用PLS-SEM分析；第二阶段对13名参与者进行半结构化访谈，以解释一个不显著的直接效应。
AI.findings: (1) 交互性和输出多样性正向预测设计自主性、定制满意度和持续使用意愿；(2) 设计自主性并不直接提升持续使用意愿；(3) 满意度完全中介了设计自主性与持续使用意愿之间的关系，表明心理赋权必须转化为对过程和产品的积极评价才能维持使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了自我决定理论中自主性满足与持续行为之间的关键中介机制——满意度，即心理赋权需通过积极的结果评价才能转化为持续使用，完善了AIGC场景下动机理论的解释链条。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生成式AI平台和大规模定制服务的设计者提供指导：不仅要赋予用户交互控制和多样化输出（增强自主感），更要确保用户在使用过程中获得满意的过程和结果体验，才能真正提升用户留存。

title: Reliability-based Process Optimization of the Surface Roughness of Laser-Cut Structural Steels Using Stochastic Emulators
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, ETH Zurich - Chair of Risk, Safety and Uncertainty Quantification, University of Trento, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Trento

detail.title: Reliability-based Process Optimization of the Surface Roughness of Laser-Cut Structural Steels Using Stochastic Emulators
detail.abstract: Structural steel components produced by laser cutting must meet prescribed surface-quality limits while remaining economically competitive, yet the strong sensitivity of cut-edge morphology to process parameters makes the identification of cost-optimal operating conditions particularly challenging. In this study, quality of cut-surface is quantified using roughness measurements obtained in the horizontal and vertical directions, together with an area roughness metric.The collected experimental data are used to train data-driven stochastic polynomial chaos expansion models that can reproduce the full stochastic response of these roughness measurements over the selected process domain. The emulators are then embedded within a reliability-based design optimization framework aimed at minimizing the operational cutting cost, while strictly enforcing upper-bound constraints on horizontal, vertical, and area roughness. During the optimization, process feasibility is ensured through a support vector classifier, trained on a dedicated cutting-ability campaign, which excludes parameter combinations associated with defective cuts. The resulting framework enables a reliability-oriented, constraint-driven exploration of the high-dimensional parameter space and identifies economically efficient cutting configurations that satisfy quality of cut surface requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于可靠性设计的优化框架，利用随机多项式混沌展开模型和支持向量分类器，在激光切割结构钢部件时，在满足表面质量约束（水平、垂直和面积粗糙度）的前提下最小化运营切割成本。
AI.research_question: 如何在满足激光切割结构钢部件表面质量约束的前提下，识别成本最优的工艺参数组合？
AI.motivation: 激光切割结构钢时，切割边缘形态对工艺参数高度敏感，使得确定成本最优的操作条件极具挑战性。现有方法难以在高维参数空间中同时兼顾质量约束与经济性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机多项式混沌展开（stochastic polynomial chaos expansion）、基于可靠性的设计优化（reliability-based design optimization, RBDO）、支持向量分类器（support vector classifier）
AI.method: 1. 通过实验收集水平、垂直及面积粗糙度数据；2. 训练数据驱动的随机多项式混沌展开模型，模拟粗糙度的随机响应；3. 将代理模型嵌入基于可靠性的设计优化框架；4. 使用支持向量分类器（基于专用切割能力实验训练）排除缺陷切割参数组合，确保工艺可行性。
AI.findings: 该框架能够实现面向可靠性的、受约束驱动的高维参数空间探索，识别出满足切割表面质量要求的经济高效切割配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 将随机多项式混沌展开与支持向量分类器相结合，嵌入基于可靠性的设计优化中，为高维工艺参数空间中的质量-成本多目标优化提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为激光切割结构钢部件提供了一种系统性的工艺参数优化方法，在保证表面质量的前提下显著降低运营成本，具有直接的工业应用价值。

title: Balance-Sheet Effects in the Tail: Large Depreciations and Corporate Investment
affiliations: City, University of London and National University of the South - Instituto de Investigaciones Económicas y Sociales del Sur (IIESS)

detail.title: Balance-Sheet Effects in the Tail: Large Depreciations and Corporate Investment
detail.abstract: How do exchange rate depreciations affect investment when firms borrow in foreign currency? Using a novel panel of 7,136 listed non-financial firms from 27 emerging market economies over 2001–2022, we revisit this question with detailed firm-level data on debt denomination. We merge Compustat Global balance-sheet information with Capital IQ Capital Structure data to construct broad measures of foreign-currency exposure. In linear specifications, we find little evidence that foreign-currency debt systematically depresses investment after a depreciation. The effect emerges, however, in episodes of large depreciations: once exchange rate movements cross high thresholds, firms with greater foreign-currency exposure cut capital expenditures significantly more. This pattern is stronger when China is excluded and is concentrated among non-tradable firms. Our findings suggest that foreign-currency debt is not inherently contractionary, but it becomes a source of vulnerability under extreme currency shocks, helping reconcile mixed results in the literature.

AI.tldr: 利用27个新兴市场国家7,136家非金融上市公司2001-2022年的面板数据，发现外币债务在一般性贬值中并不显著抑制投资，但在大幅度贬值（跨越高阈值）时，外币敞口大的企业会显著削减资本支出，这种效应在非贸易部门更明显，且排除中国后更强。
AI.research_question: 当企业借入外币债务时，汇率贬值如何影响企业投资？
AI.motivation: 既有文献关于外币债务与汇率贬值对投资的影响结论不一致，本文旨在通过大样本微观数据调和这些混合发现，尤其关注线性关系与非线性阈值效应的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产负债表渠道理论（汇率贬值通过加重外币债务负担抑制投资）、阈值效应（大型贬值触发资产负债表危机）、贸易部门与非贸易部门异质性。
AI.method: 使用Compustat Global和Capital IQ资本结构数据构建企业层面外币敞口指标，采用线性面板回归与非线性阈值回归模型，对27个新兴市场2001-2022年7,136家非金融上市公司进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）线性模型下，外币债务并未系统性压低贬值后的投资；（2）在大幅度贬值（汇率变动超过高阈值）时，外币敞口大的企业显著削减资本支出；（3）排除中国样本后效应更强；（4）效应集中在非贸易部门企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示外币债务-投资关系的非线性特征，提出"外币债务本身不具紧缩性，但在极端汇率冲击下成为脆弱性来源"的理论观点，调和了文献中的混合结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场政策制定者和企业风险管理提供启示：外币债务管理应关注极端贬值情景而非常规波动；对非贸易部门企业需加强汇率风险对冲监管。

title: Rail Layout Design Optimization for Semiconductor OHT Systems:,A Genetic Algorithm Approach with Simulation-Trained Surrogate Modeling
affiliations: Korea University, Kangwon National University and Korea University

detail.title: Rail Layout Design Optimization for Semiconductor OHT Systems:,A Genetic Algorithm Approach with Simulation-Trained Surrogate Modeling
detail.abstract: This study addresses the rail layout design problem of overhead hoist transport (OHT) systems in semiconductor manufacturing facilities, focusing on how the placement of turntables and N-branch points affects material handling efficiency and congestion patterns. A genetic algorithm (GA) is employed to systematically explore optimized rail layout configurations, and a machine learning-based surrogate model is developed to replace computationally expensive discrete-event simulation during fitness evaluation. The surrogate model takes structural features of candidate layouts as inputs and predicts six operational performance metrics. Experimental results confirm that WIP- and throughput-related metrics achieve high predictive accuracy, while ACI exhibits lower accuracy due to its dependence on microscopic vehicle interaction dynamics not fully captured by static topology features. The proposed framework provides a practical and scalable tool for rapid evaluation of rail layout alternatives, significantly reducing the design exploration cost in large-scale semiconductor manufacturing facilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种结合遗传算法与机器学习代理模型的方法，用于优化半导体制造设施中OHT系统的轨道布局设计，显著降低了设计探索成本。
AI.research_question: 转盘和N分支点的布局如何影响OHT系统的物料搬运效率与拥堵模式？
AI.motivation: 半导体制造设施中OHT系统的轨道布局设计对物料搬运效率至关重要，但传统离散事件仿真计算成本高，难以快速探索大量布局方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遗传算法（GA）、机器学习代理模型（surrogate model）、离散事件仿真
AI.method: 使用遗传算法搜索最优轨道布局，构建基于候选布局结构特征的机器学习代理模型，替代计算密集的离散事件仿真，预测六项运营性能指标。
AI.findings: WIP和吞吐量相关指标预测精度高；ACI指标因依赖微观车辆交互动态（静态拓扑特征无法充分捕捉）而预测精度较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了静态拓扑特征在预测不同性能指标时的局限性，为代理模型在复杂制造系统优化中的应用提供了理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可扩展的快速轨道布局评估工具，大幅降低大型半导体制造设施的设计探索成本。

title: Human–Machine Interface Constraints and Delayed Hazard Detection in Industrial Automation: A Case Study of Synchronized Actuator Failure
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Human–Machine Interface Constraints and Delayed Hazard Detection in Industrial Automation: A Case Study of Synchronized Actuator Failure

keywords.keywords: Industrial ergonomicsHuman-machine interface (HMI)Industrial automation safetyHazard detectionControl system failureSynchronized actuatorsManufacturing safety Operator monitoring burden

detail.abstract: ​Failures in industrial automation systems are frequently attributed to mechanical overload; however, hazardous escalation may also originate from latent synchronization-control deficiencies and insufficient operator feedback. This forensic case study investigates a real-world incident in a dual-mandrel de-coiler used in a continuous metal-processing line, where unilateral mandrel withdrawal produced asymmetric coil support and secondary structural damage.A multi-method investigation combining CCTV-based timeline reconstruction, functional control-system verification, geometric field-of-view (FOV) modelling with Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation (n = 10,000), and retrospective NASA-TLX workload profiling was conducted. Timeline analysis revealed that unilateral mandrel disengagement remained undetected for seven minutes despite continuous operator supervision. Post-hoc geometric visibility analysis quantified that 40–60% (mean visible-area fraction 50%; 95% CI [38%, 62%]) of the critical far-side mandrel motion region lay outside the operator’s effective field of view due to equipment geometry and workstation positioning. Functional testing confirmed that compromised synchronization enforcement within the translational control circuit permitted unilateral mandrel motion under nominal inputs.The findings demonstrate how synchronization-control failures and restricted HMI visibility can jointly enable prolonged unsafe conditions. A three-layer vulnerability framework (control enforcement, operator detection capability, and mechanical load integrity) is proposed, together with practical recommendations — independent synchronization alarms, redundant positional feedback, enhanced visual monitoring, and periodic interlock verification — several of which have already been implemented. This study provides industrially derived evidence quantitatively linking HMI constraints with delayed hazard detection in synchronized actuator systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多方法取证分析，揭示了一起双芯轴开卷机事故中，同步控制失效与HMI视野受限共同导致危险状态持续7分钟未被发现，并提出了三层脆弱性框架与改进建议。
AI.research_question: 工业自动化系统中，同步控制缺陷与操作员人机界面（HMI）视野受限如何共同导致危险升级？
AI.motivation: 工业自动化故障常被归因于机械过载，但同步控制缺陷和操作员反馈不足等潜在因素可能引发危险升级，需通过真实事故案例进行系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层脆弱性框架：控制执行层、操作员检测能力层、机械负载完整性层；结合蒙特卡洛不确定性传播的几何视场建模；NASA-TLX工作负荷评估。
AI.method: 多方法取证分析：CCTV时间线重建、功能控制系统验证、几何视场模型（含蒙特卡洛不确定性传播，n=10,000）、回顾性NASA-TXL工作负荷剖面分析。
AI.findings: 1）单侧芯轴脱离在连续操作员监控下持续7分钟未被发现；2）关键远侧芯轴运动区域40-60%（平均50%，95% CI [38%,62%]）位于操作员有效视野之外；3）平移控制回路中同步执行机制受损，允许标称输入下单侧芯轴运动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了控制执行、操作员检测、机械负载完整性三层脆弱性框架，量化了HMI约束与同步执行器系统中危险检测延迟之间的因果关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了独立同步报警、冗余位置反馈、增强视觉监控、定期互锁验证等实用建议，部分已被实施。

title: Infrastructure Meets Intelligence: Combining AMDG Case Infrastructure and Maestro Scenario Protocol for Digital Governance Analysis

detail.title: Infrastructure Meets Intelligence: Combining AMDG Case Infrastructure and Maestro Scenario Protocol for Digital Governance Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The AMDG case infrastructure and Diamond Hard replication protocol are the author's own independent research contributions, developed without commercial funding or institutional affiliation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data collection, case scoring, and analysis were conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Digital governance research has long struggled to combine the depth of case-based evidence with the comparability required for cumulative inference. Two separate research streams have each addressed half of this problem. The Archer Model of Digital Governance (AMDG) has constructed a reproducible, versioned, 111-case infrastructure in which national reform programmes are made structurally commensurable through a fixed template, five quantitative indices, and deterministic archetype classification. The Maestro protocol has developed a disciplined, structured method for converting that evidence into forward-looking scenario intelligence under conditions of uncertainty. This paper is a methodological-conceptual integration that moves through four analytically distinct stages: a pipeline demonstration through five cross-archetype cases; the inductive emergence of an ARMi-separation hypothesis from the Denmark–Saudi Arabia contrast; retroductive validation of that hypothesis against the top-six ARMi scorers in the full 111-case dataset (Table 5); and proposition refinement grounded in evidence drawn from three regions and two governance archetypes. The paper thus enacts the logic it recommends: moving from method demonstration to evidence-driven theoretical claim through a traceable, reproducible arc. The central empirical finding is that the Digital Skills Maturity Index (DSMI) does not adequately explain governance trajectory when taken in isolation. Saudi Arabia scores 0.944 on DSMI; Denmark scores 0.939. By conventional readiness rankings, the two countries are statistically indistinguishable. Yet their Action Research Maturity Index (ARMi) scores — Saudi Arabia 0.572, Denmark 0.803 — reveal a structural difference in adaptive governance capacity that infrastructure measurement alone cannot detect. Band analysis across the full 111-case dataset confirms that mean ARMi is essentially flat across low-, mid-, and high-DSMI cohorts (0.645, 0.637, and 0.662 respectively), establishing at scale that digital infrastructure investment has no systematic relationship with participatory governance capacity. Retroductive micro-case analysis of the six highest ARMi cases (Norway 0.860, Iceland 0.825, Sweden 0.825, Denmark 0.803, Rwanda 0.794, South Africa 0.791) confirms that high ARMi is achieved through design-stage institutional separation of participatory governance from technology delivery — not through infrastructure investment alone. This finding holds across three regions and two income-level categories, challenging Nordic exceptionalism: Rwanda and South Africa both exceed Finland (0.765) in ARMi through structurally distinct but mechanistically equivalent routes, providing cross-cultural validation of the parallel-programmes principle. The negative evidence from three US Federal programme failures — Medicare (ARMi=0.528, bottom decile), the VA Electronic Health Record Modernisation ($49.8B lifecycle cost, four veteran deaths attributable to delays), and PECOS 2.0 ($200M, nine years, zero functional output) — corroborates the structural account from the opposite direction: absence of institutional separation produces predictable and analytically coherent failure modes. The paper advances four falsifiable propositions for the research agenda, offers a practitioner-facing section of exploratory questions for digital programme commissioners, and argues that case infrastructure and scenario intelligence — integrated as the AMDG+Maestro pipeline — represent, among a small number of studies in digital governance research known to us, a methodological approach that combines reproducible large-N measurement with structured causal scenario analysis. The integrated pipeline produces what neither component produces alone: governance intelligence that is both structurally commensurable and directionally interpretable. The manuscript is published as an SSRN Working Paper; appendices are offered as an online addendum for journal submission.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合AMDG案例基础设施与Maestro情景协议，提出了一个可复现的、从案例到理论推演的数字治理研究方法论。核心发现是：数字基础设施投资（DSMI）与参与式治理能力（ARMi）无系统相关性，制度性的"机构分离"（将参与式治理与技术交付分开设计）才是高适应治理能力的真正驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 数字基础设施投资与参与式治理能力之间是否存在系统性关系？什么机制驱动了高适应治理能力？
AI.motivation: 数字治理研究长期难以兼顾案例深度与可比较性。AMDG提供了大规模结构化案例基础设施，Maestro提供了前瞻性情景方法，但二者尚未被整合为一条从方法演示到理论主张的可追溯弧线。
AI.theoretical_framework: AMDG（阿切尔数字治理模型）：通过固定模板、五个定量指数和确定性原型分类，使111个国家的改革项目在结构上可比较。Maestro协议：将证据转化为不确定性条件下的前瞻性情景情报。ARMi（行动研究成熟度指数）与DSMI（数字技能成熟度指数）的分离假设。
AI.method: 四阶段分析：1）五个跨原型案例的管道演示；2）从丹麦-沙特对比中归纳出ARMi分离假设；3）对111案例数据集前六高ARMi得分者进行溯因验证；4）基于三个地区和两种治理原型的证据进行命题精炼。
AI.findings: DSMI与ARMi无系统相关性（低/中/高DSMI队列的ARMi均值分别为0.645、0.637、0.662）。高ARMi通过设计阶段的"机构分离"（将参与式治理与技术交付分开）实现。挪威、冰岛、瑞典、丹麦、卢旺达、南非位列ARMi前六，卢旺达和南非超过芬兰，挑战了北欧例外论。美国三个联邦项目失败案例从反面提供了佐证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"ARMi分离假设"——数字基础设施投资与参与式治理能力无系统性关系；识别了"机构分离"（parallel-programmes principle）作为高适应治理能力的核心机制；挑战了北欧例外论，提供了跨文化验证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字治理研究者提供了可复现的AMDG+Maestro整合方法论；为数字项目负责人提供了探索性问题清单；指出单纯投资数字基础设施不足以提升治理能力，必须在设计阶段建立参与式治理与技术交付的机构分离。

title: Dynamic Recruitment-based harvest control rules to manage stocks with non-stationary productivity: the Iberian sardine  case study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dynamic Recruitment-based harvest control rules to manage stocks with non-stationary productivity: the Iberian sardine  case study
detail.abstract: Recruitment is a key driver of stock productivity, besides growth and natural mortality, and most stocks experience changes in recruitment productivity linked either to gradual drifts, regime shifts, or sporadic episodes of exceptionally high recruitments (like spasmodic stocks), which challenge the use of static reference points for management. In this work, two adaptative recruitment-based harvest control rules (HCRs) are proposed to manage stocks with non-stationary recruitment productivity: a) the Two Recruitment Levels-based HCR (2RL-HCR), which uses as input the mean probability of occurrence of regular/high recruitments during preceding years; and b) the Multiple Recruitment Levels-based HCR (MRL-HCR), which uses a weighted mean of past recruitment deviations (multipliers) over expectations. The rules were tested on the Iberian sardine stock, which exhibits occasionally high recruitment events and experienced historical changes in productivity. Their performance was compared to the ICES Advisory Rule and the rule currently applied to manage this fishery, using Management Strategy Evaluation throughout different plausible operating recruitment models. The recruitment-based HCRs showed an equivalent or more precautionary performance under poor productivity scenarios, and allowed similar or slightly higher precautionary catches for higher productivity scenarios. The MRL-HCR, in particular, is a fast adaptative advisory-rule, showing robust performance across all operating models without needing any upper catch limit to keep risks of dropping biomass below most putative Blim values lower than 0.05. Their fast and strong adaptability to past changes in recruitment productivity was confirmed through a simulated retrospective application on the sardine fishery. The proposed recruitment-based HCRs align with the dynamic management strategies which adapt harvest to the changes in productivity indicators without requiring understanding the drivers of those changes, like Peterman’s productivity adaptative methods and the dynamic B0 approaches. The main advantage of the recruitment-based HCRs versus ad-hoc elaborated HCRs (which may require years for their formulation, as happened with the currently applied HCR), is that they are generic and easily applicable.  These HCRs are well-suited to recruitment-driven fish stocks (like short-lived or spasmodic stocks), and can accommodate the cycles of benchmarks of most fisheries’ advisory bodies, providing a practical framework for management under non-stationary recruitment dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非平稳补充量生产力的鱼类种群，提出了两种基于补充量的自适应捕捞控制规则（2RL-HCR和MRL-HCR），并在伊比利亚沙丁鱼种群中进行了检验。结果表明，与传统规则相比，这些规则在低生产力场景下表现更谨慎，在高生产力场景下允许相似或略高的谨慎捕捞量，且具有快速适应性和通用性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计能够适应非平稳补充量生产力的鱼类种群管理规则？
AI.motivation: 大多数鱼类种群的补充量生产力存在非平稳性（渐变、突变或间歇性高补充事件），导致静态参考点不适用于管理。需要开发能动态适应补充量变化的管理规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于补充量的自适应管理；动态B0方法；Peterman的生产力自适应方法；非平稳种群动力学理论。
AI.method: 提出了两种基于补充量的捕捞控制规则（2RL-HCR和MRL-HCR），通过管理策略评估（MSE）方法，在多个合理的补充量操作模型下，与ICES咨询规则及现行规则进行性能比较，并进行了回顾性模拟验证。
AI.findings: 1) 两种基于补充量的HCR在低生产力场景下表现更谨慎或相当；2) 在高生产力场景下允许相似或略高的谨慎捕捞量；3) MRL-HCR表现稳健，无需设置上限捕捞量即可将跌破Blim的概率控制在0.05以下；4) 规则具有快速和强适应性，通过回顾性模拟得到验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了两种通用的、基于补充量指标的自适应捕捞控制规则，拓展了非平稳种群动态管理理论，证明了无需理解生产力变化驱动因素即可实现有效管理。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为短期寿命或间歇性高补充鱼类种群提供了实用的管理框架；2) 规则具有通用性和易应用性，无需像现有规则那样花费多年制定；3) 能够适应大多数渔业咨询机构的基准周期，降低管理风险。

title: Low-Latency Stress Testing for AI-Integrated Macro-Financial Risk: An Operator-Splitting Framework with Adaptive Error Calibration and Ontological Safety Controls
affiliations: Association for Financial Professionals (AFP)

detail.title: Low-Latency Stress Testing for AI-Integrated Macro-Financial Risk: An Operator-Splitting Framework with Adaptive Error Calibration and Ontological Safety Controls

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Oleksii Slieptsov, is the founder and Chief Executive Officer of Scientific Analytics Alliance Inc., which developed and operates the proprietary risk management system (including the operator-splitting framework and ontological routing layer) evaluated in this paper. The author declares no other competing personal or financial interests that could be perceived to have influenced the computational evidence or methodological claims reported in this submission.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relies exclusively on computational benchmarking and aggregated, publicly available macro-financial data. It does not involve human participants, animal subjects, clinical trials, or personally identifiable information. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval and written participant consent were not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any external funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The development of the core methodology and the supporting computational work were conducted independently and supported entirely by Scientific Analytics Alliance Inc.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This research is a computational and methodological study in quantitative finance. It does not involve human subjects, medical interventions, or healthcare outcomes, and therefore does not qualify as a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Modern macro-financial stress testing remains dominated by Monte Carlo simulation, whose latency, often measured in minutes for institutional portfolios, is structurally incompatible with the decision cadence required by large-language-model (LLM) multi-agent workflows. This paper develops a framework that addresses the latency barrier without abandoning institutional accuracy expectations or model-governance constraints in the spirit of Basel III and Federal Reserve SR 11-7. The framework rests on three components. First, a deterministic operator-splitting scheme grounded in the Trotter-Kato product formula decomposes a macro-financial shock surface into domain-specific operators whose joint evolution is reconstructed under a convergence rule. Second, an adaptive error-calibration layer monitors the cumulative splitting error on the fly and recompresses step intensity whenever the observed error approaches an institutionally tolerable terminal bound, enabling latency-accuracy trade-offs to be governed rather than improvised. Third, an ontological routing layer interposed between the numerical core and the LLM consensus layer enforces semantic class boundaries on machine-readable outputs, blocking cross-domain misclassification that would otherwise propagate as hallucination into executive-facing risk narratives. Computational evidence on a working implementation indicates that the deterministic scheme returns terminal-state estimates several orders of magnitude faster than reference Monte Carlo at comparable convergence, on commodity cloud hardware, while the adaptive calibration layer maintains terminal error within the configured institutional bound even under stressed cross-asset regimes. The contribution is methodological. Full implementation details remain proprietary to a working system operated by the author.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个确定性算子分裂框架，替代传统蒙特卡洛模拟，实现宏观金融压力测试的实时化，同时保持机构级精度和模型治理合规性，并集成LLM多智能体工作流。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持机构级精度和模型治理合规的前提下，解决宏观金融压力测试中蒙特卡洛模拟延迟与LLM多智能体决策节奏之间的结构性不兼容问题？
AI.motivation: 传统蒙特卡洛模拟延迟长达数分钟，与LLM多智能体工作流所需的实时决策节奏不兼容；现有方法无法在低延迟、高精度、模型治理合规三者间取得平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: Trotter-Kato乘积公式（算子分裂理论）；误差校准与收敛控制理论；本体论路由与语义边界分类理论。
AI.method: 三组件框架：(1) 基于Trotter-Kato乘积公式的确定性算子分裂方案；(2) 自适应误差校准层，动态监测分裂误差并调节步长；(3) 本体论路由层，在数值核心与LLM共识层之间强制执行语义边界，防止跨域误分类。
AI.findings: 确定性方案在商业云硬件上比参考蒙特卡洛模拟快数个数量级，且收敛性相当；自适应校准层能在跨资产压力情景下将终端误差控制在预设机构容忍范围内。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Trotter-Kato算子分裂理论系统应用于宏观金融压力测试的延迟优化；提出了可治理的延迟-精度权衡机制，而非经验性妥协；建立了数值计算与LLM语义层之间的本体论防护机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM多智能体驱动的实时风险管理提供了可落地的压力测试加速方案；在保持Basel III和SR 11-7合规的前提下实现了压力测试的实时化；为高管层风险叙事生成提供了防止幻觉传播的语义防护。

title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Energy Management: A Comparative Evaluation
affiliations: University of Galway and University of Galway

detail.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Energy Management: A Comparative Evaluation
detail.abstract: Energy management in distributed energy systems is inherently multi-objective, as practical operation requires balancing economic efficiency, equipment usage, service quality, and operational constraints. Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) is a natural framework for such settings, but its use in energy management remains relatively limited, and systematic comparisons of different MORL algorithms in realistic energy-management environments are still scarce. In this work, we evaluate representative MORL algorithms in two real-data-driven settings: battery scheduling and residential appliance scheduling. The MORL methods are evaluated under both MORL-specific metrics and physical and behavioral metrics that describe actual operating behavior. The results reveal distinct algorithmic tendencies: some methods achieve strong scalarized performance but converge to narrow compromise solutions, while others expose stronger preference sensitivity with different operational consequences across tasks. These findings suggest that MORL-specific metrics, such as expected utility and Pareto-front analysis, are insufficient on their own for selecting MORL algorithms in energy-management tasks and should be interpreted together with physical and behavioral metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文在真实数据驱动的电池调度和家电调度两种能源管理场景中，系统评估了多种多目标强化学习算法，发现仅依赖MORL专用指标（如期望效用和帕累托前沿分析）不足以选择合适算法，需结合物理和行为指标进行综合判断。
AI.research_question: 如何系统评估不同多目标强化学习算法在分布式能源管理任务中的表现？MORL专用指标是否足以指导算法选择？
AI.motivation: 分布式能源系统的运行本质上是多目标优化问题（经济性、设备使用、服务质量、运行约束），但MORL在该领域的应用仍然有限，且缺乏在真实能源管理环境中对多种MORL算法的系统性比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标强化学习（MORL）框架，包括标量化方法、帕累托前沿分析、期望效用等MORL专用指标，以及反映实际运行行为的物理和行为指标。
AI.method: 在两种真实数据驱动的能源管理场景（电池调度和家电调度）中，评估多种代表性MORL算法，并使用MORL专用指标（期望效用、帕累托前沿）以及物理和行为指标进行综合评估。
AI.findings: 不同MORL算法展现出不同的倾向性：部分算法标量化性能优秀但收敛于狭窄的折中解，另一些算法偏好敏感性更强，在不同任务中产生不同的运行后果。MORL专用指标单独不足以支持算法选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了MORL专用指标在能源管理任务中的局限性，提出应结合物理和行为指标进行综合评估的方法论建议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分布式能源系统中MORL算法的选择提供了实证依据和评估框架，帮助从业者根据实际运行需求选择合适的算法。

title: The Heart, The Head, and The Holy: A Moderated Mediation Model of Boycott-Induced Switching Intention
affiliations: Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Yogyakarta, Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Yogyakarta and Universitas Pembangunan Nasional Veteran Yogyakarta

detail.title: The Heart, The Head, and The Holy: A Moderated Mediation Model of Boycott-Induced Switching Intention
detail.abstract: The study investigates the psychological determinants of consumer switching intentions in ideologically motivated boycotts, focusing on how dual-valenced emotional drivers influence the decision to abandon global brands. It examines the mediating roles of attitude, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control within the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), as well as the moderating role of religiosity. A total of 355 Indonesian Muslim consumers who actively support boycott movements participated in the survey, and the data were analyzed using PLS-SEM. The findings reveal that both positive and negative emotions significantly shape the TPB cognitive components. Notably, positive emotions such as moral pride and solidarity strongly influence attitudes and enhance perceived behavioral control, challenging the assumption that boycott-induced switching intention is primarily driven by animosity. Religiosity plays a dual role by directly strengthening evaluative and normative beliefs and by significantly weakening the influence of subjective norms on switching intention, indicating a substitution effect between internalized faith and external social pressure. By integrating a dual-pathway emotional structure into the TPB framework, this study advances understanding of how affect and spirituality interact to drive consumer resistance in geopolitical contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了意识形态动机驱动下消费者抵制行为中的心理决定因素，发现正负情绪通过TPB框架影响转换意愿，且宗教虔诚度具有双重调节作用。
AI.research_question: 在意识形态动机驱动的抵制行为中，双重效价情绪驱动因素如何通过TPB框架影响消费者放弃全球品牌的转换意愿？宗教虔诚度在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于敌意等消极情绪对抵制行为的影响，忽视了积极情绪（如道德自豪感、团结感）的作用，且对宗教虔诚度在其中的调节机制缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（TPB）；双重路径情绪结构；宗教虔诚度调节作用
AI.method: 问卷调查法，收集355名积极参与抵制运动的印尼穆斯林消费者数据，采用PLS-SEM进行数据分析。
AI.findings: （1）正负情绪均显著影响TPB认知成分；（2）积极情绪（道德自豪感、团结感）显著影响态度并增强感知行为控制，挑战了"抵制转换意愿主要由敌意驱动"的假设；（3）宗教虔诚度直接增强评价性和规范性信念，同时显著削弱主观规范对转换意愿的影响，表明内在信仰与外部社会压力之间存在替代效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双重路径情绪结构整合进TPB框架，揭示了情感与精神性如何交互驱动地缘政治背景下的消费者抵抗行为，挑战了"抵制行为主要由负面情绪驱动"的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国品牌在地缘政治敏感市场中管理消费者关系提供启示，提示企业需关注消费者的积极道德情绪和宗教价值观，而非仅应对敌意情绪。

title: Who Is Missing From the Model? Algorithmic Invisibility, Governance Gaps, and a Federal Architecture for Veteran Suicide Prevention AI
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Who Is Missing From the Model? Algorithmic Invisibility, Governance Gaps, and a Federal Architecture for Veteran Suicide Prevention AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial relationships with any organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
In 2023, 6,398 veterans died by suicide. Sixty-one percent were classified by VA as Other Veterans, meaning they had no VHA facility contact in the year of death or the prior year. The Veterans Health Administration's primary suicide prediction tool, Recovery Engagement and Coordination for Health Veterans Enhanced Treatment, draws exclusively from VA electronic health records. Veterans without a VHA facility contact within the model's 24-month scoring window generate no data that the model can use. This exclusion is not random; it reflects the boundaries of the current data architecture.

This paper applies the Lifecycle Equity Framework to examine how REACH VET produces algorithmic invisibility for veterans without recent VHA contact, who account for the majority of veteran suicide deaths, including veterans classified as Other Veterans by VA, National Guard and Reserve members, rural veterans, and those whose only federal contact occurs through crisis lines, emergency care, or community outreach. It documents a governance gap in which outreach programs reach veterans who have not had recent VHA contact but generate no data to update the predictive model, leaving veterans algorithmically invisible the week after a crisis.

Two original governance contributions are proposed. First, a mandatory system-initiated three-point interval mental health contact protocol during inactive reserve status, converting the post-separation period from an unmonitored gap into a structured outreach window. Second, a Universal Risk Signal Repository aggregating post-separation screenings, Veterans Crisis Line contacts, COMPACT Act utilization, and community outreach engagement into a centralized system accessible to VA predictive AI. A legislative pathway involving a Title 10 amendment, explicit congressional authorization, and Privacy Act routine-use expansion is identified as a potential route to statutory authority.

The reviewed comparator nations do not appear to have implemented either mechanism. The governance gap is documented. The architecture is proposed. The legislative pathway is identified.

AI.tldr: VA现行自杀预测模型REACH VET仅依赖VA电子健康档案数据，导致无近期VHA接触的退伍军人（占自杀死亡者61%）被算法性忽视。本文提出两项治理方案：强制三节点心理健康联络协议和通用风险信号存储库，以填补数据架构与援助项目之间的治理鸿沟。
AI.research_question: VA自杀预测模型REACH VET如何产生算法不可见性（algorithmic invisibility），以及如何通过治理机制弥补数据架构的边界缺陷，使无近期VHA接触的退伍军人被纳入预测预警体系。
AI.motivation: 2023年6,398名退伍军人死于自杀，其中61%被VA归类为"其他退伍军人"（无死亡当年或前一年的VHA设施接触）。但VA主要预测模型REACH VET仅依赖VA电子健康档案，24个月评分窗口内无VHA接触者产生零数据，这一排除不是随机的，而是数据架构边界的系统性后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lifecycle Equity Framework（生命周期公平框架）——用于审视算法系统如何因数据架构的边界设定而对特定人群产生系统性不可见性。
AI.method: 概念性制度设计研究，结合治理缺口分析、比较法研究（审阅对照国家机制）、立法路径分析（Title 10修正案、国会明确授权、隐私法常规用途扩展）。
AI.findings: 1. REACH VET因数据源局限，系统性排除无近期VHA接触的退伍军人（占自杀死亡者多数），包括其他退伍军人、国民警卫队与预备役成员、农村退伍军人、仅通过危机热线/急救/社区外展与联邦接触者。2. 存在治理鸿沟：外展项目触达了无近期VHA接触者，但未产生数据回馈预测模型，导致退伍军人在危机后一周即恢复算法不可见状态。3. 对照国家未实施类似机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"算法不可见性"概念具体应用于退伍军人自杀预防领域，揭示数据架构边界如何系统性产生治理盲区；通过生命周期公平框架，连接数据治理与公共服务公平性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两项可操作治理机制：（1）强制系统发起的三个时间点心理健康接触协议（预备役非活跃状态期间），将退役后时期从无监控缺口转化为结构化外展窗口；（2）通用风险信号存储库，汇总退役后筛查、危机热线接触、COMPACT法案使用、社区外展参与数据至集中系统，供VA预测AI访问。同时识别出立法路径（Title 10修正案+国会授权+隐私法常规用途扩展）。

title: Towards a Strategic Human Factors Digital Twinning Framework for Transport Decarbonisation
affiliations: Heriot Watt University, Heriot-Watt University, Heriot-Watt University, University of Glasgow, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Heriot-Watt University, Heriot-Watt University and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Towards a Strategic Human Factors Digital Twinning Framework for Transport Decarbonisation
detail.abstract: The TransiT project is pioneering the use of national-scale digital twins for the purpose of rapid decarbonisation of the UK’s transport system. The transport system is designed to service humans, and therefore without adequate representation of human factors in the transport system, any digital twins are likely to be inaccurate. This paper describes a strand of research aiming to approach Human Factors digital twinning from a novel perspective. Instead of starting with computational digital twinning platforms, the approach begins the Abstraction Hierarchy (AH). The AH is then systematically connected to data sources through a novel cyber physical systems audit. This audit provides a bridge to a programmatic solution. The AH combined with the mapping of means-ends links to actual or potential cyber physical information sources. This work points towards a computationally parsimonious yet powerful and strategic Human Factors digital twinning approach. The work provides a framework to describe this approach.

AI.tldr: TransiT项目开创性地利用国家尺度数字孪生技术加速英国交通系统脱碳。本文提出了一种新的人类因素数字孪生方法：从抽象层级出发，通过网络物理系统审计连接数据源，形成一种计算精简但功能强大的人类因素数字孪生框架。
AI.research_question: 如何从人类因素视角构建交通系统的数字孪生，以支持英国交通系统的快速脱碳？
AI.motivation: 交通系统是为人类服务的，若缺乏对人类因素的充分表征，数字孪生将不准确。现有方法从计算平台出发，忽略了人类因素的系统性嵌入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抽象层级（Abstraction Hierarchy, AH），手段-目的链接（Means-ends links），网络物理系统（CPS）审计框架
AI.method: 从抽象层级出发，通过创新的网络物理系统审计将AH与数据源系统连接，进而映射到程序化解决方案。
AI.findings: 提出了一种计算精简但具有战略意义的人类因素数字孪生方法，并构建了描述该方法的框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将抽象层级理论引入数字孪生领域，提出了从人类因素出发而非从计算平台出发的数字孪生新范式；建立了AH与网络物理信息源之间的手段-目的映射关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国交通系统脱碳提供了可操作的人类因素数字孪生框架；通过CPS审计搭建了从理论到程序化解决方案的桥梁，具有计算高效性。

title: Learn-to-Adapt Algorithm: A New Continuous Optimization Method
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology and Nanjing University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Learn-to-Adapt Algorithm: A New Continuous Optimization Method
detail.abstract: Despite advances in metaheuristic optimization, key challenges remain, including balancing exploration and exploitation, preventing premature convergence, and ensuring robust performance across diverse problem landscapes. This paper presents a novel structured hybrid framework, named Learn-to-Adapt Algorithm (L2A), to deal with these challenges in continuous optimization through two key mechanisms: 1) dynamic ϵ-decay for automated exploration control, gradually shifting focus from global to local search, and 2) gradient-assisted refinement using momentum-driven updates for accelerated convergence. Unlike conventional metaheuristics, L2A’s hybrid approach systematically combines stochastic global sampling with derivative-aware local optimization within a single, cohesive algorithm, demonstrating particular effectiveness in high-dimensional, nonconvex landscapes. L2A’s performance is rigorously assessed against four state-of-the-art metaheuristics (namely CMA-ES, SHADE-ILS, L-SHADE, and jSO), and results demonstrate that it successfully maintains a balance between exploration and exploitation and consistently yields high-quality solutions. The analyzed data and score distribution graphs generated during the evaluation, along with the source code and datasets, are publicly available online [1] at: https://github.com/kashifnjust/L2A.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为L2A（Learn-to-Adapt Algorithm）的结构化混合框架，通过动态ϵ-decay机制和梯度辅助细化策略，在连续优化问题中有效平衡探索与开发，防止过早收敛，并在高维非凸问题上表现出优于CMA-ES、SHADE-ILS等前沿元启发式算法的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个结构化混合框架，在连续优化问题中同时解决探索与开发的平衡、防止过早收敛以及确保跨不同问题地形的鲁棒性能等关键挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有元启发式优化算法在平衡探索与开发、防止过早收敛以及确保跨多样问题地形的鲁棒性能方面仍存在不足，亟需一种能够系统结合随机全局采样与导数感知局部优化的新型混合算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态ϵ-decay机制（自动控制探索向开发的转换）、动量驱动梯度辅助细化（加速收敛）、随机全局采样与导数感知局部优化的混合策略。
AI.method: 提出L2A（Learn-to-Adapt Algorithm）结构化混合框架，包含两个关键机制：1) 动态ϵ-decay用于自动化探索控制，逐步从全局搜索转向局部搜索；2) 基于动量更新的梯度辅助细化用于加速收敛。通过与CMA-ES、SHADE-ILS、L-SHADE和jSO四种前沿元启发式算法的对比实验进行性能评估。
AI.findings: L2A成功维持了探索与开发之间的平衡，持续产出高质量解，在高维非凸景观中尤为有效，性能优于CMA-ES、SHADE-ILS、L-SHADE和jSO等对比算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将动态ϵ-decay探索控制与动量驱动梯度辅助细化有机结合的统一混合框架，为元启发式优化中探索与开发的平衡问题提供了新的解决思路。
AI.practical_contributions: L2A算法在处理高维、非凸连续优化问题上展现出优越性能；代码、数据集及评估结果均已在GitHub上开源，便于复现和应用。

title: An Interpretable AI-Based Decision-Support System for Adaptive Reservoir Operation under Climate Stress
affiliations: , Nankai University, University of Tabriz, University of Tabriz and University of Tabriz

detail.title: An Interpretable AI-Based Decision-Support System for Adaptive Reservoir Operation under Climate Stress
detail.abstract: Efficient reservoir operation under climate variability requires not only accurate inflow prediction but also intelligent decision-making mechanisms that translate forecasts into adaptive release strategies. This study presents an interpretable AI-based decision-support system that integrates deep learning, hybrid metaheuristic optimization, and system dynamics simulation to improve multi-sector reservoir management under hydrological uncertainty. The proposed framework combines (i) a forecast module based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks using multi-source hydro-climatic inputs with cyclical encoding, (ii) an explainability layer employing Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) to quantify predictor contributions, and (iii) a hybrid Genetic Algorithm-Particle Swarm Optimization (GA-PSO) engine for deriving adaptive operating policies. A key contribution lies in the formulation of a demand-adaptive objective function and modified performance indices that enable equitable allocation across competing water-use sectors while capturing both partial and complete shortages. The framework is applied to the Alavian Dam system in Iran under multiple hydrological scenarios, including wet, normal, drought, and severe drought conditions. Results demonstrate that the hybrid optimization consistently reduces shortage magnitudes and vulnerabilities compared to conventional operation policies, while the LSTM model achieves high predictive accuracy across a 12-month forecast horizon (NSE up to 0.90). SHAP analysis further enhances transparency by identifying snow cover, precipitation, and lagged inflows as dominant drivers of inflow variability. By coupling interpretable forecasting with optimization-based decision-making, the proposed system generates adaptive rule curves that improve resilience and sustainability of reservoir operations under climate stress.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个可解释的AI决策支持系统，结合LSTM深度学习、混合GA-PSO优化和系统动力学模拟，通过需求自适应目标函数和SHAP可解释性分析，在水文不确定性下优化水库多部门运营管理。在伊朗Alavian大坝的应用表明，该方法相比传统策略显著降低了缺水程度和脆弱性，并提高了运营透明度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个集成了深度学习预测、混合元启发式优化和可解释性分析的AI决策支持系统，以在水文不确定性下提高水库多部门运营管理的效率和韧性？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧了水文不确定性，传统水库运营策略在应对多部门水资源竞争时存在局限性。现有研究缺乏将高精度预测、优化决策与模型可解释性三者有效整合的框架，导致决策者难以信任和采纳AI驱动的运营方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习（LSTM）时间序列预测理论、混合元启发式优化（GA-PSO）理论、可解释AI（SHAP）理论、系统动力学理论、水库运营多目标优化理论
AI.method: (1) 基于LSTM的预测模块（多源水文气候输入+循环编码）；(2) SHAP可解释性层量化预测因子贡献；(3) 混合GA-PSO优化引擎推导适应性运营策略；(4) 需求自适应目标函数和修正性能指数实现多部门均衡配水；(5) 在伊朗Alavian大坝系统进行多种水文情景验证。
AI.findings: (1) 混合优化相比传统策略显著降低了缺水程度和脆弱性；(2) LSTM模型在12个月预测期内达到高精度（NSE最高0.90）；(3) SHAP分析揭示积雪覆盖、降水和滞后入流是入流变化的主要驱动因素；(4) 系统生成了适应性的规则曲线，提高了气候变化压力下的运营韧性和可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了一种将可解释AI与优化决策耦合的新框架，弥合了预测与决策之间的鸿沟；(2) 构建了需求自适应目标函数和修正性能指数，更精细地刻画了部分短缺与完全短缺场景下的多部门均衡配水问题。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为水库管理者提供了一个可解释、可信任的AI决策支持工具，有助于在气候多变条件下制定更具韧性的适应性运营策略；(2) 在伊朗Alavian大坝系统的实证应用验证了框架的有效性，为类似地区的水资源管理提供了可复制的实践范式。

title: Leadership Practices used by Principals to Provide Support for Teachers to Engage in Emergency Remote Teaching During the Initial Period of Lockdown of the Pandemic

detail.title: Leadership Practices used by Principals to Provide Support for Teachers to Engage in Emergency Remote Teaching During the Initial Period of Lockdown of the Pandemic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: "Ethical approval for this study was obtained from the University of the West Indies, Open Campus, Institutional Review Board (IRB Protocol #CREC-OC.0038/12/2020) on February 9th, 2021. All participants provided informed consent."
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract:
From independence in 1962 until early March 2020, stakeholders of government primary schools had little to no experience with the use of technology for daily teaching and learning. However, with the coming of the COVID-19 pandemic, there was a sudden radical shift in the educational landscape to prevent the spread of the disease and save lives. Thus, school leadership had to become leaders of virtual schools and provide support for teachers to engage students in this new environment. The purpose of this qualitative study was to determine government primary school principals' leadership practices used to support their teachers to engage in emergency remote teaching during the initial period of lockdown of the COVID-19 pandemic; to discover if there is a relationship between the leadership practices and teachers' perceptions of support, and to investigate the extent to which those leadership practices influenced teachers' perceptions of support to engage in emergency remote teaching. Principals and teachers of government primary schools from one borough in St. George East, Trinidad, completed online surveys, which included demographic data as well as other survey questions about principals' leadership practices used to provide support for teachers in the initial lockdown period of the COVID-19 pandemic, and then a purposive sample participated in interviews. 
"Note: This document is an extract from an original, unpublished research paper completed in August 2024 titled '[ PRINCIPAL LEADERSHIP AND TEACHER PERCEPTION OF SUPPORT FOR EMERGENCY REMOTE TEACHING]'."

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了特立尼达和多巴哥政府小学校长在COVID-19疫情封锁初期，为支持教师进行紧急远程教学所采取的领导实践，以及这些实践如何影响教师对支持的感知。
AI.research_question: 政府小学校长在疫情封锁初期使用了哪些领导实践来支持教师进行紧急远程教学？这些领导实践与教师对支持的感知之间是否存在关系？这些领导实践在多大程度上影响了教师对支持的感知？
AI.motivation: 该国自1962年独立至2020年3月前，政府小学几乎未有技术用于日常教学的经验。疫情迫使学校突然转向远程教学，校长需要成为虚拟学校的领导者，因此有必要了解校长如何通过领导实践支持教师应对这一前所未有的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定性研究方法，基于校长领导实践与教师感知支持的关系框架。
AI.method: 定性研究，采用在线问卷调查（含人口统计数据及关于校长领导实践的问题）和目的性抽样访谈，研究对象为特立尼达圣乔治东区一个自治区的政府小学校长和教师。
AI.findings: 待论文全文揭示，但研究旨在明确校长在紧急远程教学初期采取的领导实践及其对教师支持感知的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解疫情背景下学校领导力在紧急远程教学中的作用提供了实证依据，补充了关于校长领导实践与教师感知支持关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府小学管理者在危机情境下如何有效支持教师提供实践指导，特别是在技术基础设施薄弱的环境中推动远程教学。

title: An Improved Projection and Splitting Algorithm for High Dimensional Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization: Application to Expert Team Recommendation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Tsinghua University - Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School

detail.title: An Improved Projection and Splitting Algorithm for High Dimensional Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization: Application to Expert Team Recommendation
detail.abstract: Multi-objective combinatorial optimization (MOCO) problems require identifying the complete Pareto front across conflicting objectives, yet exact algorithms based on region partitioning suffer from exponential growth in stored subregions as the number of objectives increases. This paper proposes an improved projection and splitting algorithm that replaces exhaustive region splitting with a bound-updating mechanism. Instead of generating $2^{L-1}$ subregions per iteration, the proposed method produces at most $L$ new subregions, reducing the worst-case space complexity from $\mathcal{O}(2^{(L-2)|Y_N|})$ to $\mathcal{O}(L^{|Y_N|})$, where $L$ is the number of objectives and $|Y_N|$ is the number of non-dominated solutions. Completeness, Pareto optimality, and region uniqueness guarantees are fully preserved. A volume-based region selection strategy is further introduced and proven optimal under mild conditions on the search space. The algorithm is validated on synthetic benchmark instances with $L = 3$ to $7$ objectives and on a real-world expert team recommendation problem using the ca-sandi\_auths co-authorship network. The expert team recommendation problem is formulated as a seven-objective MOCO problem encompassing subject coverage, academic productivity, collaboration potential, innovation index, rank similarity, coauthor ratio, and research balance. Computational results show that the proposed algorithm achieves speedups of $2\times$ to $8\times$ over state-of-the-art exact algorithms and remains tractable at $L = 7$, where competing exact methods time out. A case study demonstrates the practical value of the complete Pareto front for priority-driven team selection and sensitivity analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的投影与分割算法，通过边界更新机制替代穷举式子区域分割，将最坏情况空间复杂度从指数级降低到多项式级，并在3到7目标的MOCO问题以及专家团队推荐问题上验证了2到8倍的加速效果。
AI.research_question: 如何高效求解多目标组合优化问题的完整帕累托前沿，缓解区域分割算法在目标数量增加时子区域呈指数增长的瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 多目标组合优化问题的精确算法基于区域分割，但随着目标数量增加，存储的子区域数量呈指数增长，导致算法在目标数较多时变得不可行。因此需要一种更高效的算法来降低空间复杂度，同时保持解的完整性和最优性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投影与分割算法、边界更新机制、帕累托最优性理论、空间复杂度分析、基于体积的区域选择策略。
AI.method: 提出边界更新机制替代穷举性子区域分割，每次迭代最多生成L个新子区域（而非2^(L-1)个）；引入基于体积的区域选择策略，并在搜索空间的温和条件下证明其最优性；在合成基准实例（3-7目标）和真实ca-sandi_auths合著网络上的专家团队推荐问题（7目标）上进行验证。
AI.findings: 最坏情况空间复杂度从O(2^((L-2)|Y_N|))降至O(L^|Y_N|)；算法在3到7目标实例上比现有最优精确算法快2到8倍；在7目标级别，对比方法超时而本算法仍可运行；专家团队推荐案例展示了完整帕累托前沿在优先级驱动团队选择和敏感性分析中的实用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上证明了所提出的边界更新机制能够保持解的完整性、帕累托最优性和区域唯一性；证明了基于体积的区域选择策略在温和条件下的最优性；将空间复杂度从指数级降低到多项式级。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种可扩展到7个目标的实用精确MOCO算法；构建了一个七目标专家团队推荐问题的完整公式；通过案例研究展示了完整帕累托前沿在实际决策中的价值。

title: Research on the Prediction Model of Liquid Level in the Closed Paste Filling Goaf Based on the Stacked LSTM-Attention Framework
affiliations: Hebei University of Engineering, Hebei University of Engineering, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hebei University of Engineering, Hebei University of Engineering, Hebei University of Engineering and Hebei University of Engineering

detail.title: Research on the Prediction Model of Liquid Level in the Closed Paste Filling Goaf Based on the Stacked LSTM-Attention Framework
detail.abstract: Back-support closed paste filling is critical for green and safe coal mining, yet goaf filling level prediction remains challenging due to harsh environments and complex fluid dynamics. This paper proposes a simulation-driven prediction framework using a stacked LSTM-Attention fusion network (DLSTM-Att). First, a Simulink model of the paste filling system is built under 16 working conditions (including pump wear, pipeline blockage, and sensor drift) to generate and augment time-series datasets. Then, a stacked LSTM-Attention model is constructed to learn nonlinear temporal dependencies. Results show the proposed model achieves an R² of 0.89, RMSE of 0.144 m, and MAE of 0.086 m. Compared with single-layer and double-layer LSTM, the RMSE is reduced by 15.8% and 8.3%, respectively, outperforming BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, and Transformer. Ablation experiments confirm that the stacked LSTM reduces RMSE by 8.2%, and self-attention further decreases RMSE by 4.5% and MAE by 23.2%. The model maintains an R² of 0.86 under 10 dB noise interference and achieves an R² ≥ 0.86 and RMSE ≤ 0.235 m on 4 untrained conditions, meeting industrial accuracy requirements. This work provides an effective solution for intelligent monitoring of paste filling processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于堆叠LSTM-Attention融合网络（DLSTM-Att）的仿真驱动预测框架，用于煤矿膏体充填采空区充填水平预测。在16种工况下生成时间序列数据，模型R²达0.89，RMSE为0.144m，优于多种基线模型，并在噪声干扰和未训练工况下保持良好性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在恶劣环境和复杂流体动力学条件下，实现采空区膏体充填水平的准确预测？
AI.motivation: 膏体充填对绿色安全采煤至关重要，但采空区充填水平预测因环境恶劣和流体动力学复杂而极具挑战，现有方法难以满足工业精度要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 堆叠LSTM（Stacked LSTM）用于学习非线性时序依赖；自注意力机制（Self-Attention）用于捕捉关键时间步特征；仿真驱动数据生成（Simulation-driven data generation）解决数据匮乏问题。
AI.method: 首先构建包含16种工况（泵磨损、管道堵塞、传感器漂移等）的Simulink膏体充填系统仿真模型，生成并增强时序数据集；然后构建堆叠LSTM-Attention融合网络（DLSTM-Att）进行预测。
AI.findings: DLSTM-Att模型R²为0.89，RMSE为0.144m，MAE为0.086m；相比单层LSTM，RMSE降低15.8%；相比双层LSTM降低8.3%；优于BiLSTM、CNN-LSTM和Transformer；堆叠LSTM使RMSE降低8.2%，自注意力使RMSE降低4.5%、MAE降低23.2%；在10dB噪声下R²仍达0.86；在4种未训练工况下R²≥0.86且RMSE≤0.235m。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了堆叠LSTM与自注意力机制融合的深度学习架构，有效捕捉充填过程中的非线性时序依赖；验证了仿真驱动数据生成在工业过程预测中的可行性，为数据稀缺场景提供了方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为煤矿膏体充填过程提供了高精度、抗干扰的智能监测方案；模型在不同工况和噪声环境下保持良好性能，满足工业实际应用要求，有助于推动绿色安全采煤的智能化发展。

title: A TWO-PHASE STRATEGY FOR MONITORING DESIGN IN SEWER NETWORKS BASED ON CONTAMINATION BACKTRACKING
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Kore University of Enna

detail.title: A TWO-PHASE STRATEGY FOR MONITORING DESIGN IN SEWER NETWORKS BASED ON CONTAMINATION BACKTRACKING
detail.abstract: The diffusion of contaminants within sewer networks is a highly complex process. The increasing size and intricate structure of these systems, characterized by numerous potential entry points, make their management particularly challenging. To address this issue, several monitoring strategies have been developed to intercept contamination sources and/or track their spread, thereby supporting intervention priorities.,This work proposes a two-phase strategy for the progressive design of a monitoring system in sewer networks. In the first phase, a depth-first search algorithm is applied to generate a contamination criticality map, namely a ranking of node criticality based on their impact on contaminant diffusion. In the second phase, a tailored topological metric, the Relevance-based In-harmonic centrality, is used to identify the most suitable nodes for sensor placement. The novelty of the approach lies in incorporating information about each node’s capacity to diffuse contaminants throughout the system, defined as the node's criticality, Cn.,The strategy provides a ranking of node importance in the contaminant diffusion process to identify the most suitable nodes for sensor placement, enabling progressive improvement in sensor positioning despite spatial, technical, and economic constraints.,The proposed strategy is presented and validated on a reference sewer system reported in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段监测策略，用于在排水管网中逐步设计污染物监测系统：第一阶段通过深度优先搜索算法生成污染关键性地图，第二阶段利用基于相关性的非调和中心性指标选择最佳传感器布设节点。
AI.research_question: 如何在空间、技术和经济约束下，为排水管网设计渐进式的污染物监测系统，以有效拦截污染源并追踪污染物扩散？
AI.motivation: 排水管网规模日益增大、结构日益复杂，且存在大量潜在污染物入口点，使得污染物的扩散管理极具挑战性，亟需高效的监测策略来支持干预优先级决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度优先搜索算法；基于相关性的非调和中心性（Relevance-based In-harmonic centrality）拓扑指标。
AI.method: 两阶段策略：第一阶段使用深度优先搜索算法计算各节点的污染物扩散影响，生成节点关键性排名（关键性地图）；第二阶段利用基于相关性的非调和中心性指标，识别最适合放置传感器的节点。
AI.findings: 该策略能够提供节点在污染物扩散过程中的重要性排序，从而识别最适合传感器布设的节点，在空间、技术和经济约束下实现传感器布置的渐进式优化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将节点在系统中扩散污染物的能力（节点关键性Cn）纳入传感器布设的拓扑指标中，提出了基于相关性的非调和中心性这一新指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为排水管网管理者提供了一种渐进式、可扩展的传感器布置方案，能够在实际约束条件下逐步优化监测系统性能，提升污染源拦截和扩散追踪的效率。

title: Routing Heterogeneous Drones with Automated Battery Swapping Machines for Multi-Customer Last-Mile Delivery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Texas State University and Texas State University

detail.title: Routing Heterogeneous Drones with Automated Battery Swapping Machines for Multi-Customer Last-Mile Delivery
detail.abstract: This study considers the routing problem of a drone-based last-mile delivery network equipped with automated battery swapping machines (ABSMs). In this system, heterogeneous drones are adopted to satisfy customers’ delivery demand, while ABSMs are installed to extend drones’ coverage. Unlike most existing studies that assume a homogeneous fleet and restrict each drone to serving only one or two customers per trip, we allow each drone to serve multiple customers within a single route. We formulate the routing problem as a Mixed Integer Linear Program that minimizes total delivery cost while accounting for payload limits, energy consumption, and battery swapping decisions. To address computational complexity, we develop an efficient branch-and-price algorithm. This study contributes a new modeling and solution approach by explicitly incorporating intermediate ABSM locations as operational decision points within an energy- and capacity-constrained routing setting, and by relaxing conventional ”one-customer-per-trip” assumptions. Numerical experiments demonstrate the scalability of the proposed solution algorithm, and sensitivity analyses illustrate the impact of load capacity and flight range on system performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究配备自动化电池更换站（ABSM）的无人机最后一公里配送网络路径规划问题，提出考虑异构无人机、多客户服务、载荷与能耗约束的混合整数线性规划模型，并开发分支定价算法求解，通过数值实验验证算法可扩展性。
AI.research_question: 如何在配备自动化电池更换站的无人机最后一公里配送网络中，优化异构无人机的多客户路径规划，以最小化总配送成本？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多假设同质无人机车队，且限制每架无人机每趟仅服务1-2个客户，未能充分利用无人机配送潜力。本研究旨在突破这些限制，允许异构无人机在单次行程中服务多个客户，并纳入电池更换决策以延长覆盖范围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）；分支定价算法；能量与容量约束下的路径优化理论。
AI.method: 构建MILP模型，考虑异构无人机、载荷限制、能耗和电池更换决策；设计分支定价算法求解；通过数值实验和敏感性分析验证算法性能。
AI.findings: 所提出的分支定价算法具有良好的可扩展性；载荷能力和飞行里程对系统性能有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将中间ABSM位置明确纳入能量与容量约束的路径规划中作为运营决策点；突破了传统“每趟一客户”的假设，提出更灵活的异构无人机多客户配送建模与求解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无人机最后一公里配送网络的实际运营提供优化决策支持，帮助企业降低配送成本、提升无人机使用效率；为自动化电池更换站的布局与运营提供定量分析工具。

title: Replacing Portland cement can increase concrete’s carbon footprint: a strength-dependent efficiency framework for cementitious binder sustainability
affiliations: Politecnico di Torino, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Politecnico di Torino

detail.title: Replacing Portland cement can increase concrete’s carbon footprint: a strength-dependent efficiency framework for cementitious binder sustainability
detail.abstract: The substitution of ordinary Portland cement (OPC) with supplementary cementitious ma-terials (SCMs) is the dominant industrial strategy for decarbonising concrete construction. Yetcurrent environmental assessments universally quantify the benefit per unit mass of binder, ignoring the higher dosages required to achieve equivalent compressive strength — an overdosage that partially or entirely erodes the apparent carbon advantage. Here we show, through a closed-form dimensionless framework grounded in Abrams’ strength law, that the net carbon efficiency of any cementitious binder is not an intrinsic material property but a function of the target strength class. We introduce three dimensionless descriptors — mechanical efficiency ψα, carbon intensity ψϵ, and water sensitivity ψβ — from which we derive a net efficiency parameter η and an Ashby-type Binder Environmental Performance Plane of Efficiency (BEPPE). A central result is that the geometric structure of the sustainability map is preserved under the extension to binder-specific water sensitivity, which acts as a rescaling of carbon intensity through an effective parameter ψeffϵ = ψϵ ψβ .
